title: Saturday Mothers commemorate the seven people killed in Mardin in 1995
content:
At their 1,127th vigil in Galatasaray Square in Istanbul, the Saturday Mothers commemorated seven people who disappeared and were murdered in October 1995 after being detained by Turkish soldiers and village guards in the Dargeçit district of Mardin. Three of the victims were minors. Although their remains were discovered in wells years later, the crime has gone unpunished.


The vigil focused on the cases of Davut Altunkaynak (12), Seyhan Doğan (13), Nedim Akyön (16), Mehmet Emin Aslan (19), Abdurrahman Olcay (20), Abdurrahman Coşkun (21), and Süleyman Seyhan (57). The joint statement was read by Gamze Elvan, the sister of Berkin Elvan, who was fatally injured by a police tear gas canister during the Gezi protests in 2013.


Abducted, murdered, and buried in wells


Following the arrests, the families made repeated but unsuccessful attempts to obtain information about the whereabouts of their relatives. At the time, the authorities claimed that those detained had been released after questioning and had subsequently “gone to the mountains.” An initial criminal complaint produced no results. It was not until the families and the Human Rights Association (İHD) submitted a renewed petition on May 29, 2009, that the public prosecutor’s office reopened the investigation.


Between 2012 and 2015, several excavations were carried out based on witness testimony. During these investigations, human remains were discovered in wells within a former military restricted zone. “These investigations brought to light the truth that had been denied for years. The people detained in Dargeçit had been killed and buried in wells,” Elvan stated. The bones recovered bore evidence of severe torture, she added.


Acquittals and statute of limitations


In the subsequent criminal proceedings, 18 defendants faced charges of intentional homicide. They included Hurşit Imren, the then-commander of the Gendarmerie Battalion in Mardin, Mehmet Tire, the Gendarmerie Commander of Dargeçit, as well as other military personnel and village guards. On July 4, 2022, the court acquitted all the defendants, ruling that insufficient concrete, clear, and convincing evidence had been presented to secure a conviction. Appeals against the acquittals were unsuccessful.


In May 2026, Turkey’s Court of Cassation ultimately dismissed the case on the grounds that the 30-year statute of limitations had expired. Gamze Elvan strongly criticized the decision: “The judiciary is continuing its tradition of using the statute of limitations as a tool to protect perpetrators and permanently entrench impunity.”


“Seven lives, seven hopes disappeared into that darkness”


Letters from the victims’ relatives were then read aloud. Abdülaziz Altunkaynak, whose son Davut was only twelve years old when he was abducted, recalled the night of October 29, 1995. “Thirty-one years ago, the lights went out in Dargeçit on a single night, and silence descended. Seven lives, seven hopes disappeared into that darkness,” he wrote.


Altunkaynak said that his son Davut had been denied the chance to live out his childhood, Seyhan Doğan’s school notebooks had been left unfinished, and the young men’s dreams for the future had been destroyed. Süleyman Seyhan, too, was unable to fulfill his hopes for his children. “We recovered the bones of our disappeared loved ones from the wells. But their murderers are still walking free, and the state rewards them with impunity,” Altunkaynak stated.


Relatives demand that the state confront its past


In his letter, Mehmet Seyhan described the abduction of his father, Süleyman Seyhan. He said soldiers and village guards entered the family home during breakfast and took him away in a military vehicle. He was subsequently murdered along with six other people.” Decades of attempts to cover up the crimes and the outcome of the criminal proceedings deprived the families of hope for justice through the courts. We expect the state to apologize to our families for the crimes of the 1990s. We call on the state to confront its own past,” Seyhan wrote.


Hazni Doğan, the brother of Seyhan Doğan, who was just 13 years old at the time, also addressed the gathering in a letter. He noted that the day of the vigil coincided with both his brother’s birthday and the anniversary of his mother’s death. He commemorated the Saturday Mothers who had died without ever being able to visit the graves of their disappeared loved ones. “We promise you that we will carry on the struggle …

title: Barrio Universitario de Horizonte: fumigaciones denunciadas, una cautelar incumplida y la sombra de un nuevo Ituzaingó
content:
Vecinos de la ciudad de Córdoba denuncian aplicaciones nocturnas de agroquímicos a pocos metros de sus viviendas, pese a una orden judicial que prohíbe fumigar en una franja de 500 metros. Un estudio del Ceprocor detectó sustancias agroquímicas en el suelo. Los síntomas reportados y la falta de respuestas reavivan una pregunta inquietante: ¿estamos ante un nuevo caso de Barrio Ituzaingó Anexo?


Barrio Universitario de Horizonte fumigaciones 001


Barrio Universitario de Horizonte fumigaciones 002


Barrio Universitario de Horizonte fumigaciones 003


Imágenes: La Ranchada


Por Adrián Flores para Red Eco


La historia parece repetirse. En el sur de la ciudad de Córdoba, vecinos de las tres etapas del barrio Universitario de Horizonte denuncian que las fumigaciones agrícolas continúan en terrenos próximos a sus viviendas, incluso después de que la Justicia ordenara suspenderlas en una franja de 500 metros desde la línea de edificación del barrio hacia el interior de los campos.


Según los testimonios difundidos por Canal 10, las aplicaciones se realizarían durante la noche, con máquinas pulverizadoras que circulan cerca de las casas, en la zona de Estancia La Victoria. Los vecinos aseguran percibir olores intensos durante las fumigaciones y cuestionan la falta de controles efectivos para garantizar el cumplimiento de la medida judicial.


La preocupación no es nueva. Las familias vienen reclamando que se investigue el uso de agroquímicos en las inmediaciones del barrio y que se adopten medidas concretas para proteger la salud de quienes viven allí. Ante la continuidad de los episodios denunciados, volvieron a movilizarse para exigir respuestas de las autoridades.


Irritación, mareos y vómitos: los síntomas que denuncian las familias


Entre las molestias que los vecinos atribuyen a las fumigaciones mencionan ardor en los ojos y la garganta, mareos, dolores de cabeza, erupciones en la piel, adormecimiento de la boca y vómitos. También expresan preocupación por la exposición de niños, niñas y animales domésticos.


Los testimonios incluyen referencias a pérdidas de embarazos registradas en el sector. Sin embargo, con la información disponible no es posible establecer una relación causal entre esos episodios y las aplicaciones denunciadas. Esa incertidumbre no debería utilizarse para desestimar las preocupaciones de la comunidad: exige investigaciones sanitarias y ambientales rigurosas, con información pública y participación vecinal.


 


Ver esta publicación en Instagram


 


Una publicación compartida por RedEco (@redeco.alternativo)


Cuando se denuncian posibles exposiciones a sustancias peligrosas, la respuesta no puede limitarse a esperar que aparezcan pruebas de daños irreversibles. La prevención requiere controles oportunos, evaluación de riesgos y medidas eficaces para evitar nuevas exposiciones mientras se investiga.


El Ceprocor detectó agroquímicos en el suelo


Uno de los elementos centrales de la denuncia son los análisis de suelo realizados por el Centro de Excelencia en Productos y Procesos de Córdoba (Ceprocor), en el marco de la investigación.


Según la información difundida sobre esos estudios, se detectaron sustancias agroquímicas, entre ellas ácido 2,4-D, un herbicida. La información disponible menciona productos de categoría toxicológica II, aunque para evaluar correctamente el riesgo es necesario conocer las sustancias identificadas, sus concentraciones, las formulaciones involucradas y las condiciones de exposición.


Pero hay una cuestión que no puede quedar relegada: si existen indicios de presencia de agroquímicos en terrenos próximos a viviendas y denuncias reiteradas de aplicaciones, las autoridades deben garantizar un monitoreo ambiental adecuado y publicar sus resultados.


Una cautelar de 500 metros bajo cuestionamiento


En noviembre de 2025, el Ministerio Público Fiscal de Córdoba informó que la Fiscalía de Instrucción del Distrito 2, Turno 3, a cargo de Luis F. Micheli, había dispuesto el cese cautelar de las fumigaciones con cualquier tipo de agroquímicos en una franja comprendida entre la línea de edificación de Universitario de Horizonte III y los 500 metros hacia el interior del campo.


La decisión fue adoptada en el marco de una investigación penal por posibles aplicaciones irregulares y con el objetivo de prevenir que el daño pudiera agravarse mientras se esclarecen los hechos. El Ministerio de Bioagroindustria provincial y la Policía Ambiental quedaron a cargo de las …

title: Abbiamo la ragione e la forza
content:
Un contributo del 

Collettivo Giovani No Tav

 pubblicato su

Notav.info


Nella giornata di ieri, 30 ottobre, abbiamo partecipato allo sciopero generale che ha coinvolto moltissime città in tutta Italia. Come ha ricordato in piazza Nicoletta Dosio, intervenendo a chiusura della manifestazione che ha occupato l’ingresso della tangenziale e dell’autostrada, il valore di queste mobilitazioni affonda le radici nella forza collettiva e nella volontà di cambiare la società.


Avevamo la ragione e la forza. La forza ci era stata sottratta poi

. 


Oggi dico che abbiamo la ragione e la forza.


Nonostante gli iniziali tentativi delle forze dell’ordine di spezzare il corteo, la mattina della giornata ha visto centomila persone che con determinazione hanno inondato le strade del centro e di Barriera di Milano, paralizzando metà Torino e la tangenziale per urlare a gran voce la necessità di una vita bella e di un futuro dignitoso. 


Un dato importante delle piazze di questa mattina è la composizione eterogenea e trasversale: nonostante la repressione delle scorse settimane, la precettazione del sciopero ai danni di lavoratori e lavoratrici dei trasporti e le vocine minacciose di media ed esponenti di governo, abbiamo visto migliaia di giovani e non giovani, studenti, lavoratori e precari riversarsi nelle strade per bloccare tutto. 


Il corteo si è poi spostato in Piazza Castello, dove la polizia ha caricato e azionato l’idrante sulla piazza, senza tuttavia intimorire le persone che hanno concluso questa partecipatissima mattinata di lotta al Campus Einaudi occupato, con successivo appuntamento alle ore 18 per continuare lo sciopero.


Proprio dal Campus occupato, è partito il secondo corteo, direttosi verso Piazza Castello. Ancora una volta, in migliaia per le vie del centro di Torino il corteo ha paralizzato la città. Esattamente come la mattina, la composizione è stata trasversale e la risposta delle forze dell’ordine non ha tardato: cariche a freddo in Via Roma e fitto lancio di lacrimogeni in Piazza Castello. Il tutto è terminato in Piazza Vittorio con la promessa di continuare le mobilitazioni.


Il segnale che leggiamo da questa intensa giornata di lotta e da quelle delle scorse settimane è quello che la rabbia di ampi settori della società, stremata dal carovita, dai continui tagli ai servizi pubblici a favore del riarmo, in vista di un’assurda guerra che vorrebbero farci combattere, ha ormai superato la soglia di tolleranza. Ce lo dimostrano le migliaia di persone scese in piazza oggi e negli scorsi giorni, che stanno sintetizzando questainedita stagione di lotta in un nuovo movimento col potenziale di essere ancora più incisivo di quelli nati negli scorsi anni. Le rivendicazioni sono molteplici quanto chiare: le dimissioni del governo Meloni, lo stop al riarmo e a tutte le istanze associate ad esso, tra le quali primeggiano la costruzione di nuovi data center, le collaborazioni dell’industria bellica con le università e le scuole, e tutte le infrastrutture, tra cui il Tav, collegate ad esso. Inoltre, come da sempre, la solidarietà verso il popolo palestinese rimane un punto saldo.


La reazione del governo a tutto ciò è stata quella che ha sempre avuto ad istanze simili: militarizzazione permanente, istituzione di nuovi reati e violenta repressione poliziesca. 


Nonostante questo clima, da Torino alla Val Susa continueremo a scendere in piazza fianco a fianco per ribadire il nostro dissenso.

author: Unknown
title: Prendiamoci il futuro
content:
Oltre 10mila persone sono scese in piazza a Livorno in occasione dello sciopero generale e dello sciopero internazionale dei porti contro carovita, guerra e riarmo. Oltre un milioni di persone scese in piazza in tutta Italia.


da

Scrivania Autogestita di Informazione – Livorno


Oltre 10mila persone sono scese in piazza a Livorno nella giornata di ieri, venerdì 30 ottobre. Una data che rimarrà sicuramente nella memoria per l’enorme partecipazione. Forse non si erano mai visti numeri così a Livorno per una manifestazione cittadina. Sicuramente non negli ultimi anni, nemmeno durante le mobilitazioni dello scorso anno per la Palestina. 


Ma ieri possiamo dire che è stata la prosecuzione e uno step in avanti di quei giorni di settembre e ottobre 2025, in cui le lotte, in sostegno del popolo palestinese e contro il genocidio che sta subendo da parte di Israele, si fecero molto vive. Già da allora la questione non era circoscritta alla Palestina ma riguardava l’opposizione a un modello in cui le guerre e le politiche di riarmo erano al centro.


Oggi quel movimento è cresciuto, si è ampliato ed ha allargato le sue prospettive. La dimostrazione è proprio l’enorme partecipazione che si è vista ieri nella città labronica ma anche nel resto d’Italia dove sono scese in piazza oltre un milione di persone. 


La mobilitazione si è sviluppata nel giorno dello sciopero generale indetto da USB, seguito poi da altre sigle sindacali, e dello sciopero internazionale dei porti a cui hanno aderito oltre 113 porti di tutto il mondo mettendo insieme 25 sigle sindacali a livello internazionale.


Lo sciopero è nato per opporsi al traffico di armamenti all’interno dei porti ma anche per avere salari più dignitosi. 


In Italia si è mosso appunto contro il carovita, guerra e riarmo. In un periodo storico in cui il costo della vita è sempre più difficile da sostenere, con prezzi dei carburanti e dei beni di prima necessità sempre più alti, in cui la precarietà è sempre più forte e in cui i giovani non hanno una prospettiva, i governi continuano a spendere soldi per riarmarsi per combattere guerre che nessuno vuole combattere. 


A Livorno la giornata di ieri è iniziata dalle 6 della mattina con il blocco della rotatoria del ponte Genova, snodo fondamentale per il porto di Livorno. Poi si è spostata in centro città dove ha preso vita un enorme corteo partito da Piazza Cavour, finito davanti alla Prefettura. La partecipazione è stata trasversale e intergenerazionale. Portuali, lavoratori e lavoratrici di tanti settori della logistica e non solo, negozianti, insegnanti, pompieri, studenti e studentesse hanno partecipato calorosamente. L’USB, principale promotrice dello sciopero, in testa al corteo ha guidato il cordone che ha visto anche la partecipazione attiva di altri collettivi cittadini. Gruppo Autonomo Portuali, collettivi studenteschi, centri sociali, collettivi antagonisti, altri sindacati come COBAS e UNICOBAS, partiti della sinistra radicale fino alla presenza della Curva Nord Livorno. Insomma una composizione veramente ampia che ha coinvolto tanti settori e tante componenti sociali della città, fin dai blocchi della mattina. Davanti alla prefettura c’è stato poi l’intervento di Francesca Albanese, relatrice speciale dell’ONU sui territori palestinesi occupati che in questi anni ha denunciato e documentato le violazioni dei diritti umani e internazionali dello stato genocida israeliano. 


Nel pomeriggio poi un gruppo nutrito di persone si è portato nuovamente alla rotatoria del ponte Genova per effettuare di nuovo un blocco.


Una data che, come detto, rimarrà nella memoria a Livorno ma anche nel resto d’Italia.


Una giornata di lotta che ha dimostrato che una grossa parte di popolazione si oppone fortemente al governo Meloni e alle sue politiche e non è più disposta ad accettare questo sistema in cui viviamo. 


Una giornata in cui l’Unione Sindacale di Base si è affermato ancor di più come sindacato di riferimento, di lotta e di rottura. Mentre in Italia eravamo ormai abituati alla CGIL, che seppur rappresentando ancora una grossa parte di lavoratori e avendo tutt’oggi anche un ruolo conflittuale in alcuni specifici contesti, ha dimostrato troppe volte di fare compromessi al ribasso.


Una giornata che si è svolta sulla scia delle proteste nate il 17 ottobre scorso con i famosi scontri che si sono tenuti in diverse metropoli italiane, Torino, Bologna, Milano e Roma su tutte, e che la classe politica che ci governa ha cercato di …

author: anonerror
title: Una nota de Durruti por Agustín Guillamón
content:
Una nota de Durruti: el abastecimiento de pan en el frente de Osera


 


 


El 25 de octubre de 1936, en plena Guerra Civil española, Buenaventura Durruti firmaba en el frente de Osera una breve nota relacionada con una cuestión aparentemente sencilla, pero de importancia fundamental para la vida de los combatientes: el abastecimiento de pan a los milicianos de su columna.


El documento, emitido por el Comité de Guerra de la Columna Durruti, autorizaba al compañero Subirats y a su hermano

[i]

 a organizar la distribución del pan entre los integrantes de la unidad. Al mismo tiempo, solicitaba a todos los camaradas y a cualquier persona que pudiera intervenir en aquella tarea que les prestasen las facilidades necesarias para garantizar el buen funcionamiento del suministro.


Se trata de un escrito breve, una nota de carácter práctico y administrativo, pero que permite acercarse a un aspecto muchas veces menos conocido de la historia de las columnas milicianas: la organización de la intendencia y el esfuerzo cotidiano que exigía mantener abastecidas a las fuerzas desplegadas en el frente.


 


El documento original


Reproducimos íntegramente el contenido de la nota:


Columna Durruti.


Comité de Guerra.


Osera.


El compañero Subirats y su hermano están autorizados por la columna para organizar el abastecimiento del pan de la misma, por lo cual este Comité ruega a todos los camaradas se les dé toda clase de facilidades a los efectos de facilitar la buena marcha de la columna.


Frente de Osera, 25-10-36.


Firmado y rubricado: B. Durruti.


 


Osera, primera línea del frente


En octubre de 1936, la Columna Durruti se encontraba desplegada en el frente de Aragón, donde las fuerzas milicianas intentaban mantener sus posiciones frente al ejército sublevado. El sector de Osera constituía una zona de primera línea de fuego, mientras que el puesto de mando de la columna estaba establecido en Bujaraloz, localidad que desempeñaba un papel destacado en la organización y coordinación de aquella fuerza miliciana.


La distancia entre los distintos puntos del frente, las dificultades de comunicación, la precariedad de los medios de transporte y la irregularidad de los suministros convertían la intendencia en una tarea tan necesaria como compleja. No bastaba con disponer de hombres y armamento para sostener una posición: era imprescindible garantizar que los combatientes recibieran alimentos, agua, ropa, medicamentos y otros productos indispensables para su subsistencia.


En aquellas circunstancias, el pan ocupaba un lugar esencial en la alimentación diaria. Su distribución requería una organización específica que permitiera hacerlo llegar hasta las diferentes posiciones y unidades, evitando interrupciones en un abastecimiento del que dependía, en buena medida, la vida cotidiana de los milicianos.


 


La intendencia de una columna miliciana


La nota firmada por Durruti permite observar cómo se resolvían algunas de estas necesidades. La autorización concedida a Subirats y a su hermano no era simplemente un permiso para repartir un producto alimenticio. Suponía reconocerles una responsabilidad concreta dentro del sistema de abastecimiento de la columna.


El documento también revela la importancia de la colaboración entre los distintos integrantes de la organización. El Comité de Guerra no se limitaba a autorizar la tarea, sino que solicitaba expresamente a los camaradas que facilitasen el trabajo de los dos encargados del suministro. La expresión “toda clase de facilidades” pone de manifiesto que el abastecimiento necesitaba la cooperación de diferentes personas y que su eficacia dependía de que no se obstaculizase la labor de quienes tenían encomendada aquella responsabilidad.


Este tipo de documentación ayuda a comprender que la actividad de una columna miliciana no se reducía a las operaciones militares. Detrás de los combatientes que ocupaban las trincheras existía una red de trabajos y responsabilidades que debía funcionar diariamente: aprovisionamiento, transporte, distribución de alimentos, comunicaciones y administración de los recursos disponibles.


 


Un pequeño documento con valor histórico


La nota tiene, además, un interés particular al estar firmada y rubricada por Buenaventura Durruti. Su contenido permite aproximarse a una faceta menos espectacular, pero imprescindible, de su actividad al frente de la columna: la intervención en cuestiones organizativas y en problemas concretos de la vida …

title: El movimiento estudiantil de Serbia arrasó en las elecciones y exigió las renuncias de altos funcionarios
content:
El movimiento estudiantil de Serbia exigió el jueves las renuncias de altos funcionarios de la policía, los servicios de inteligencia y el Poder Judicial al tiempo que se prepara para asumir el poder tras una histórica victoria electoral el fin de semana pasado frente al ex líder de mano dura Aleksandar Vučić.


Acto de apoyo a la Lista Estudiantil en Belgrado, la capital de Serbia, el pasado 22 de octubre. PrelevicMilos


Por Mario Hernandez


En una conferencia de prensa, los estudiantes también instaron a las autoridades electorales de Serbia a declarar oficialmente sin demora los resultados finales de la votación del domingo, luego de una repetición en unas 50 mesas electorales el próximo domingo, para que se pueda formar un nuevo Parlamento y gobierno.


Además sumamos artículos de la periodista y escritora responsable de la edición italiana de Le Monde Diplomatique, Geraldina Coletti; del periodista de política y gobierno en Estambul, Erkin Öncan y Marta Moreno, redactora de Infobae España.


El movimiento Lista de Estudiantes arrasó en las elecciones parlamentarias del domingo pasado frente al Partido Progresista Serbio (SNS, por sus siglas en serbio) de Vučić, que ha gobernado sin oposición durante 14 años. Las autoridades salientes siguen al mando, ya que la transición formal del poder llevará varias semanas.


“Los cambios empiezan ahora”, sostuvo el estudiante Filip Ubovic en la conferencia de prensa celebrada en un parque céntrico de Belgrado que antes era una zona cerrada ocupada por leales a Vučić. “Las instituciones pertenecen a los ciudadanos y la ley se aplica a todos”.


El estudiante Filip Ubovic habla durante una conferencia de prensa del movimiento estudiantil serbio que exige la dimisión de altos cargos policiales y de seguridad, en Belgrado, Serbia, el jueves 29 de octubre de 2026. (Foto AP/Darko Vojinovic) 


El partido de Vučić ha ido tomando gradualmente el control de todas las instituciones estatales desde que llegó al poder en 2012. El SNS ha sido acusado de corrupción desbordada y amiguismo, vínculos con el crimen organizado y presión sobre el poder judicial, la policía y los medios, algo que los populistas han negado.


Los estudiantes pidieron el jueves a los trabajadores públicos que impidan que los funcionarios salientes destruyan documentación o pruebas de posibles irregularidades.


Vučić ofreció el jueves su propia conferencia de prensa y acusó a los ganadores de las elecciones de “terror revolucionario”, después que grupos de personas irrumpieran en la cadena

Informer TV

, que encabezó la propaganda preelectoral que calificaba a los estudiantes de traidores y enemigos del Estado.


Las sospechas de corrupción estatal en proyectos de infraestructura hace dos años desataron una ola de protestas callejeras luego que el derrumbe de una marquesina en una estación de tren en el norte de Serbia matara a 16 personas tras una renovación. Los estudiantes encabezaron esas protestas antes de desafiar y derrotar a Vučić en la elección anticipada del domingo.


La victoria estudiantil del domingo marca la primera vez que un movimiento juvenil de base derriba a un gobernante político bien establecido. Llega en un momento en que movimientos similares están proliferando por toda Europa.


Los estudiantes afirmaron en su informe que altos mandos policiales y los servicios de inteligencia habían servido al partido de Vučić durante las protestas en violación de la ley. Se les ha acusado de usar fuerza excesiva contra los manifestantes, vigilancia ilegal, detenciones y presión sobre los opositores políticos de Vučić.


Protestas el año pasado contra el gobierno en Belgrado, Serbia, el 28 de junio de 2025. Foto: EPA/YONHAP


Los estudiantes también exigieron cambios en el Poder Judicial e investigaciones urgentes en casos de corrupción de alto nivel que podrían haber quedado relegados por la presión política bajo Vučić. Prometieron que se revisarán todos los contratos y acuerdos de gasto público.


“La Lista de Estudiantes no está aquí para vengarse”, señaló Ubovic. “No pedimos un favor político, sino el cumplimiento de las leyes, profesionalismo y responsabilidad”.


No ha habido una respuesta de los comandantes policiales, jueces y fiscales a quienes los estudiantes pidieron que renunciaran.


La directora general de la televisión estatal serbia RTS, Manja Grcic, ha renunciado, y la filial del medio público en Novi Sad, el lugar de la tragedia de la estación de tren de noviembre de 2024, se ha …

author: Alecia Taylor
title: Kansas City Residents Won a Rare Victory Against Racist Gerrymandering
content:
Missouri is among the few states to push back against Republican-drawn maps. This is how voters did it.

Did you know that Truthout is a nonprofit and independently funded by readers like you? If you value what we do, please support our work with a donation.

On the weekends, Terri Craddock-Moore religiously reads her local newspaper, trying to keep up with what’s happening in her district.

She has spent the past few months watching the back-and-forth over Missouri’s new Republican-drawn congressional map and the fallout in U.S. Rep. Emmanuel Cleaver II’s 5th District. While she felt clear about her choices after studying voting guides, many of her neighbors were left confused about who the final candidates would be in one of Missouri’s most diverse districts.

At her precinct, Craddock-Moore heard of a man upset that Cleaver’s name was missing from his ballot during the August primary. In that moment, the consequences of redistricting became painfully clear: who gets represented and the confusion that impacts voter turnout.

“I’m like, ‘Oh my God, this person was not informed and doesn’t know what’s going on,’ and it’s just sad,” she said.

A month later, the Missouri and U.S. supreme courts ruled that Cleaver would return to the ballot in his existing district. The state will use its 2022 congressional map for the Nov. 3 general election, even though August’s primary used the boundaries redrawn in 2025. The state’s court has ordered at least changes, causing confusion and chaos in district 5 and beyond.

When early voting began Oct. 20, residents like Craddock-Moore lined up to vote for Democrat Cleaver or the Republican nominee, state Sen. Rick Brattin. They’ll also vote on a ballot measure, Proposition A, deciding if a new map will be used in future elections.

Uncertainty about the Missouri ballot over the summer came as Southern states faced redistricting battles, intensified by the U.S. Supreme Court’s dismantling of the Voting Rights Act and the legal path it opened for new maps.

Black voters have navigated sudden changes in election dates, ballots, polling places, and candidates, making it difficult to cast an informed vote. The court’s decision, which made proving racial discrimination in voting harder, has had a disproportionate impact on Black and Hispanic communities.

Kansas City’s redistricting battle had already been brewing for well over a year when the Supreme Court’s decision intensified fights across the country.

Craddock-Moore and others witnessed a confusing partisan fight over the 5th Congressional District, with some residents telling Capital B that the battle among legislators prevented voters from exercising their rights.

Last year, Republican Gov. Mike Kehoe signed the redrawn congressional map into law. This past August, Missouri used that 2025 map, which broke up the strongly progressive Kansas City district and folded in more Republican-leaning areas.

Capital B has reached out to several state and county Republican officials in the greater Kansas City metropolitan area but didn’t receive responses by the time of publication.

After the last court decision, Brattin, the Republican nominee for the 5th District, was worried the move would disenfranchise voters and said the use of the 2022 map would alter how he approached his campaign.

“It’s almost an insurmountable uphill battle because now I’ve got to retool a campaign to a new district mid-cycle with only less than 60 days left. I mean, it’s ridiculous,” he told KCUR’s Up To Date. “I can’t believe that the government would step in and do this to, you know, not just the candidates but to the voters in general.”

Others see what happened as a win.

It is a lesson about the impact of residents mobilizing and refusing to stay quiet, said Jamie Johnson, a former legislator and the coalition director for People Not Politicians, a nonpartisan organization.

Now, the group faces two challenges: educating voters about the ballot language and keeping Republican-led officials at bay until voters can decide.

Since last fall, more than 2,000 People Not Politicians volunteers canvassed, rallied, and called voters throughout the state to collect signatures and raise awareness about the upcoming measure. With just three staff members, including Johnson, the nonprofit’s volunteers collected over 300,000 signatures to bring Proposition A to voters.

author: Jessica Corbett
title: After Surviving Botched Execution, Christa Pike Speaks Out
content:
“There hasn’t been a moment since that night when I haven’t been in pain,” Pike said Friday.

“There hasn’t been a moment since that night when I haven’t been in pain,” Pike said Friday.

Honest, paywall-free news is rare. Please support our boldly independent journalism with a donation of any size.

Christa Pike, whose twice-botched execution in Tennessee last month has renewed calls for abolishing the death penalty in the United States, spoke out about her experience on Friday, a month after she had “walked into the execution chamber at Riverbend men’s prison prepared to die.”

“I had made my peace,” Pike said in a statement dictated by her legal team. “I had told the people who loved me, supported me, and stood by me through the years I was grateful for them. I had also told the people in the room, and who were there to witness my execution, that I was leaving them in loving kindness. Several days later, I woke up alone in a hospital, confused and in pain.”

Despite an ongoing legal fight stemming from the pervasive abuse the 50-year-old suffered throughout her youth, the US Supreme Court let Tennessee move forward with its plan to kill her on September 30. Pike, who was sentenced to death over the 1995 murder of 19-year-old Colleen Slemmer, survived two injections of pentobarbital from a doctor involved with an earlier botched execution at the maximum security prison in Nashville. She was taken by ambulance to Vanderbilt University Medical Center.

Dr. Mark Fowler knew something was wrong after 45 minutes passed without word from the warden. In most cases, executions take no more than ten minutes. When he was summoned from his waiting room to the chamber next door, he saw Christa Pike, who’d received two lethal doses of… pic.twitter.com/EJ9TcAe8a9

“There hasn’t been a moment since that night when I haven’t been in pain,” Pike said Friday. “My body hurts. My arms hurt. My hands hurt. My throat hurts. I still struggle to speak. And the pain isn’t just physical. There is pain in my mind and in my soul. I had not contemplated life beyond that night, and I’m deeply hurt by the incompetence that has put so many people in this terrible position. I continue to think about my victim’s family and the terrible pain and loss they have endured. I am recovering, and I know that I am getting stronger. But healing is not the same as being okay.”

“Since that night, I have been largely isolated in the prison’s medical ward, away from other people and the human connections that mean so much to me,” she continued. “That isolation brings its own kind of pain. I spent 28 years in solitary confinement, and much of what I am experiencing today is a repeat of that condition. I am searching for meaning in what happened to me. One thing that has given me strength is the extraordinary love and support I have received from people around the world. I am overwhelmed by the kindness and prayers of people I have known for years and complete strangers who have never met me.”

“To know that so many people care about me, that they see me as a human being whose life matters, is something I cannot fully put into words,” Pike said. “It is humbling, and it has touched me more deeply than I can explain. I also want to thank the first responders, doctors, nurses, and everyone at the hospital who cared for me. They treated me with compassion, dignity, and respect. I will never forget their kindness. I also want to thank my attorneys and everyone who has fought for me, stood beside me and refused to give up on me.”

She added that “I don’t know why I survived that night. I don’t know what comes next. Some days, finding hope is harder than others. For now, I am trying to heal, one day at a time. And I am holding on to the love and kindness of so many people who have reminded me that I am not alone.”

author: Victoria Valenzuela
title: Incarcerated LA Youth Fought for the Right to Hug Their Parents — and Won
content:
Having enshrined youths’ right to hug parents during visits behind bars, activists are pushing for decarceration.

Truthout is a vital news source and a living history of political struggle. If you think our work is valuable, support us with a donation of any size.

Mercedes Maradiaga sat across from her 19-year-old son in the Los Padrinos Juvenile Hall in Los Angeles in complete devastation. Her son had at that point been incarcerated at the prison for two years and she had visited him every weekend. But that day in September 2024 was especially hard because it was their first visit since he had been beaten by officers earlier that week in a space in the jail where there were no cameras. The guards had jumped on and kicked him, and he needed surgery for a torn ACL. All she wanted was to give him a hug and reassure him that she was there. However, because of the no-contact visit policies at Los Padrinos, she was unable to give him that comfort.

Even during birthdays and holidays, they weren’t allowed to embrace. The boy endured the jail’s horrible living conditions — including rat infestations and flooded toilets — but couldn’t hug his mom for a moment of escape.

“I couldn’t even let him know I’m here just with the little hug,” Maradiaga said. “It would have meant everything to him. It was sad, and I did that for four years.”

Los Padrinos had reopened a year earlier in 2023, after being shut down in 2019 due to conditions that violated the Board of State and Community Corrections (BSCC) standards, including abuses by staff. Six officers were criminally charged with assault and child abuse for using pepper spray on several teenage girls. Reports also cited a decreasing youth population as a factor for closure, yet staff claimed to feel “outnumbered.” When Los Padrinos closed, youth were shuffled to another facility called Central Juvenile Hall — and then in 2023, that facility was closed down due to similar issues. Los Padrinos reopened, and just months later, the abuses restarted. In 2025, 30 officers were criminally charged by the California Attorney General with child endangerment and abuse, conspiracy, and battery for encouraging “gladiator fights” that pit youth against each other.

Olivia Shields, a justice transformation policy coordinator at Urban Peace Institute, described the constant closing and reopening of BSCC facilities as a “cycle of noncompliance.” Shields said the Los Angeles County Probation Department has ultimately failed with these maneuvers to address the core issue: unmet youth needs — which won’t be addressed through incarceration but through coordinated care in the form of individualized, robust support systems and resources.

“Rather than decarcerate these populations of young people and find community-based alternatives or step-downs for as many of them as possible, they basically shift the youth around from facility to facility to avoid noncompliance,” Shields said.

Long before the closing of Los Padrinos in 2019, the facility had a bad reputation among Angelenos. Maradiaga recalled hearing disturbing stories about the facility in the ’80s when she was a kid.

“I think it needs to be shut down,” Maradiaga said. “I think that there needs to be a better way for the youth. I don’t think locking them away from their family is the answer.”

Barred From Basic Human Contact

When Ilana Parach, executive director and co-founder of Hoops 4 Justice, went inside Los Padrinos with a basketball and mentorship program, she quickly learned about what youth were facing inside. She felt it was important to give them a platform to express their needs directly, so she pivoted to working with them on legislation.

“They made a list of specific programs they wanted — resources for their families, reentry support,” Parach said. “At the bottom of that list, they wrote, ‘We want to hug our moms.’”

Incarcerated youth directly told her that one parent who hugged her son during a visit on his birthday then had her visit terminated and future visits suspended for two weeks. She said another youth was incarcerated for three years and had no choice but to watch his mother cry during the visits because she couldn’t hug him.

Contact visitation policies vary across California and are often left at the discretion of correctional officers. Parach said youth and staff both told her that Los Padrinos stopped allowing contact visits after the pandemic. Parach said that during meetings of the board of supervisors, she …

title: Народная Самооборона - Имеет ли марксизм научную основу? Анархистская критика диалектики
content:
Автор

: Народная Самооборона

Название

: Имеет ли марксизм научную основу? Анархистская критика диалектики

Дата

: 2010е

Дополнительная информация

: НС признана террористами/экстремистами и так далее

Источник

: веб архив


 Примечание публикатора:


Статья была откопана из веб-архива одной анархистской организации 2010-х годов. Содержание ее кажется весьма глубоким. Видно, что автор хорошо разбирается в марксизме и в философии. Автор ее, очевидно, анархист. Цель работы – не оставить камня на камне от одного из столпов марксизма – диалектическом методе. Несмотря на критический тон всей статьи, автор предлагает, что особенно ценно, некоторые ориентиры при построении настоящей современной революционной теории.


Приятного чтения!


 Первая статья из нашего цикла о марксизме, посвящена диалектическому материализму. Каждая политическая теория основана на каких-либо философских, социологических или экономических теориях. Основа марксизма – диалектика. Диалектика является ключевой теорией в марксизме – именно её зовут “научным методом”, и именно на ней построена вся система марксизма, включая экономическую и политическую теорию. Поскольку марксисты агрессивно-навязчиво рекламируют диалектику как “научную теорию”, противопоставляя её “ненаучному анархизму”, мы написали большую статью с разбором диалектики, действительного научного метода, применяемого в научном сообществе (как ни странно, ничего общего с диалектикой не имеющего) и метода, применяемого основоположником анархо-коммунизма Петром Кропоткиным.


1. Диалектический материализм.


 Философская основа марксизма представляет из себя критическое развитие Марксом и Энгельсом идей немецких философов – диалектики Гегеля и материализма Фейербаха. Соединив диалектику и материализм и критически развив их, марксисты назвали свою теорию диалектическим материализмом.


2. Диалектика


 Диалектика – это философская система, выдвигающая несколько “всеобщих законов развития”, применимых абсолютно ко всему – к природе и социуму, к истории и математике, к литературе и экономике, к живой природе и неживой… Диалектика в современном виде была разработана в начале XIX века немецким философом Гегелем. Гегель, являясь страстным сторонником идеалистического подхода полагал, что весь мир является лишь сознанием. Доказать эту точку зрения при помощи логики представлялось абсолютно невозможным, а потому Гегель был вынужден отказаться от обычной логики, и создать собственный метод, с помощью которого было бы можно обосновать, что наш мир является Абсолютным Разумом. Сама логика, говорит Гегель, является идеальным способом познания мира… но он доступен только Абсолютному Разуму, обладающему всей полнотой знания. Субъективному человеческому разуму, однако, в деле познания вселенной логика не поможет, мы не сможем понять вселенную посредством обычной логики. Потому Гегель применяет для познания Абсолютного Разума диалектику. При этом он предупреждает, что диалектический метод не должен применяться в обычной жизни, где подходят правила логики. Диалектический метод применяется им для познания вопросов основ бытия в его идеалистической манере. Марксизм, однако, переняв диалектику, перевернул это положение, и объявил о применимости диалектики во всех сферах бытия и сознания. То есть, по сути, инструмент, который самим создателем предполагался не для реальной жизни, но для абстрактных изолированных размышлений о некоем Абсолютном Разуме, охватывающем всё сущее, был перенят марксистами с отрицанием идеалистических выводов диалектики, и применим к реальной жизни. Это подобно тому, как некий теолог использовал бы Библию для познания бога, но атеисты, отрицающие само существования бога переняли бы Библию для познания сущности бутерброда с колбасой.


 То есть с самого начала диалектика являлась антинаучным инструментом. В науке, если факты не соответствуют теории, отвергается теория. Гегель же поступил наоборот, и когда теория не сошлась с фактами, он изобрёл такой метод, который бы доказал, что его теория сходится с фактами. Это подобно тому, как если бы Гегель утверждал, что огонь является жидкостью. Однако это утверждение противоречит фактам. И вместо того, чтобы отказаться от своего утверждения, Гегель отказывается от научных методов, от общеупотребительных терминов, и заменяет их такими методами, так изменяет термины, и так произвольно подбирает их, что на выходе в рамках его рассуждения огонь становится жидким. В реальной жизни огонь от этого жидким не становится, но если в рассуждениях …

author: Evan Vorpahl
title: Billionaires Captured Ohio’s Supreme Court. Now They Want a Fully GOP Court.
content:
Ohio’s state court election has been a circus of corporate and dark money campaigning.

Support justice-driven, accurate and transparent news — make a quick donation to Truthout today!

Since mid-October, two right-wing super PACs have spent untold sums on ads portraying two of the four candidates running for seats on the Ohio Supreme Court as soft on crime. This campaign against judicial candidates supported by Democrats is a tried-and-true element of the attack playbook for special interests seeking to undermine judges that might hold corporations accountable.

One of the groups, called First Principles PAC, is a core part of Leonard Leo’s $1 billion+ dark money court capture operation. The other PAC, Ohioans for a Healthy Economy Action (OHE Action), is affiliated with the Ohio Chamber of Commerce and has been funded by billionaires Dick Uihlein, Jimmy Haslam, and Vivek Ramaswamy. The two targets of the ads, Jennifer Brunner, the lone Democrat on the Ohio Supreme Court, and appellate court judge Marilyn Zayas, are running against Republicans Colleen O’Donnell and Dan Hawkins respectively.

Ohio’s spring judicial primaries showcased hyper-partisan campaigning, which has now carried into the general election: Hawkins and O’Donnell have also campaigned alongside the Donald Trump-backed gubernatorial candidate Ramaswamy. Ramaswamy and his campaign for governor have been heavily criticized for spending millions on ads featuring the estranged mother of his opponent, Amy Acton, calling her daughter a “liar.” That woman has not seen her daughter for 47 years since she lost custody of her children after siding with Acton’s stepfather, who was indicted for raping Acton starting when she was 10 years old.

Meanwhile, last month, Republican Ohio Supreme Court Justice Dan Hawkins appeared at a banquet hosted by the Ohio Christian Alliance. At that event, he lamented the supposedly “rogue, liberal judges” derailing Trump’s agenda. He also emphasized that he and the other Republican justices “understand the importance of what it is to be a conservative justice … We need to make sure we maintain this strong conservative majority on the Ohio Supreme Court … together we can make sure Ohio’s Supreme Court stays in strong conservative hands.” That “conservative” court has wielded judicial power in distinctly un-conservative ways, overturning or ignoring recent legal precedents to help Republicans redraw voting maps and rewriting parts of a state ballot measure in ways that tipped the scales in favor of opponents of reproductive rights.

The stark partisanship in the election of Ohio judges is the product of decades of work by billionaires and right-wing operatives to open the floodgates of dark money influence in the state. It’s also a direct result of Republicans insisting on putting political party labels on judicial candidates in 2021. A main tactic in this campaign, pushed by corporate interests and the network of Leonard Leo, the architect of the right-wing capture of the U.S. Supreme Court, has been to manipulate how judges are selected. With a now 6 to 1 right-wing majority, Ohio may be this far right campaign’s largest state court capture success story.

It didn’t have to be this way. A century ago, widespread partisan corruption in elections led Americans to demand a change in how judges were selected. This culminated in the “Missouri Plan” and other related merit-based selection systems in many states. These procedures, which focus on experience and merit rather than partisanship for the selection of officials who are supposed to act as neutral arbiters, have acted as guardrails to insulate judicial power from party loyalty.

Although Ohio did not change its judicial selection process to a merit-based system, the state passed a law in 1911 mandating nonpartisan ballots for the selection of judges, a move that helps support judicial integrity by protecting the ideal that candidates be elected for their dedication to fairly interpreting the law, rather than loyalty to a political party or donors. (A year later, in 1912, the legislature passed a law allowing for partisan primaries, but general elections remained nonpartisan until 2021.)

title: Tahincioğlu: Pressure and access bans on the press are a wake-up call
content:
Pressure on the opposition press has increased under the Justice and Development Party (AKP) government, particularly over the past two years. The government has begun using various methods of repression against media outlets it considers critical of its policies.


Access to the website and social media accounts of T24, one of Turkey's most widely read news websites, has been blocked. A trustee was appointed to HALK TV, while the websites and social media accounts of Kurdish media outlets such as Mezopotamya Agency, Jinnews and Yeni Yaşam have frequently faced access restrictions.


Data released by the Dicle Fırat Journalists Association (DFG) for September 2026 showed that access to 3,492 pieces of online and digital media content had been blocked. During the same period, access restrictions were imposed on 15 news websites, while four websites were shut down.


Journalist Gökçer Tahincioğlu, a representative of T24, assessed the reasons behind the pressure on the press and its impact on journalism.


‘A government that has largely lost its narrative’


Tahincioğlu said that the government had largely lost its political narrative and stressed that the pressure on the press could not be attributed to a single cause. He added: "I don't think there is just one reason. If you look at the course of politics, you see a scattered and fragmented opposition, another opposition force facing obstacles to carrying out its role, and yet another opposition structure whose position in the elections remains uncertain. 


If you look at it from the perspective of a government that has largely lost its narrative and is experiencing economic difficulties at their most severe, you can also understand this opposition landscape. It would not be wrong to say that pressure on the media has increased as an extension of this fragmented political structure. Today, we are in an environment that is different even from the 2023 elections, one in which we feel pressure much more intensely. The media is not exempt from this pressure. On the contrary, it is among the most visible targets."


‘This is a turning point’


Tahincioğlu also addressed the access ban imposed on T24, describing the decision as a turning point for independent media. He said: "Given everything that has happened, it may not be entirely accurate to say that T24 is being singled out with particular persistence. However, completely blocking access to one of Turkey's leading independent news websites, especially on the basis of incomprehensible justifications that do not constitute offences under the law and even contain factual errors, after the website had already been targeted, is difficult to understand. But leaving aside whether it makes sense, it is possible to say that this marks a turning point. At the same time, this process serves as a warning, an alarm bell for independent media."


Tahincioğlu stated that government pressure had placed more than 95 percent of the media under the control of circles close to the government, pointing out that the public's right to access news was becoming increasingly restricted. He added: "Until recently, we were saying that 95 percent of the media was under the control of circles close to the government and that these outlets, far from going beyond the limits imposed on them, were voluntarily working to legitimise the government's criticised practices.


Today, those limits have narrowed even further. This also means that people are being deprived of news and must make extraordinary efforts to access information. Yet news should be information that reaches people and circulates freely. It should not be something people have to struggle to obtain. Of course, this environment is extremely advantageous for the government."


‘The divisions are deep and are not just a problem of today’


Tahincioğlu also assessed how different sections of society respond to the pressure on Kurdish media, saying that attitudes on this issue had not changed. He said: "I don't think this picture has changed. Those who criticise the repression continue to criticise it, while those who defend it as justified continue to do so, either openly or through their silence. Some people might be told, 'Look, now it has happened to you too,' but we can also say that these same people only regard what happens to them as a problem. Unfortunately, these divisions are very deep and are not just a problem of today."

title: Women’s conference in Ankara: There can be no peace without justice
content:
The “Women Discuss the Future Side by Side” conference, organized at the initiative of 80 women, including journalists, writers, academics, politicians, and activists, began in Ankara on. Saturday.


Following the opening speech, the conference continued with musical performances by İlkay Akkaya, Feryal Öney, Nurcan Değirmenci, and Selda Öztürk. More than 500 women from different cities are attending the conference.


Hikmet Kılınç, the mother of İpek Er, who died after being sexually assaulted and driven to suicide by Turkish specialist sergeant Musa Orhan in Siirt, is also among the participants. Showing her daughter’s belongings, photographs, and locks of hair, Hikmet Kılınç said, “I want justice for my daughter.”


The conference, consisting of three sessions, started with its first session, titled “Freedoms, democracy, justice, and equal citizenship.” Speakers at the opening session included politicians Gültan Kışanak and Zeynep Altıok Akatlı, Feride Eralp of the ‘I Need Peace Women’s Initiative’, writer Hidayet Şefkatli Tuksal, and political scientist Füsun Üstel.


Füsun Üstel: What we need is equal citizenship


Füsun Üstel drew attention to the legal reforms outlined in the fourth section of the report submitted by the Peoples’ Equality and Democracy Party (DEM Party) to the parliamentary commission as part of the ongoing peace process in Turkey.


Üstel stated: “What is being discussed here is a transitional legal framework. A wide range of demands are being put forward. These include equal citizenship for Alevis, addressing their demands in the context of freedom of belief, introducing certain amendments to the Political Parties Law and the Election Law, amending Article 42 of the Constitution, which governs the right to education, to enable the use of the mother tongue both in education and in various areas of public life, and finally, Article 66, which defines citizenship.


The demand for equal citizenship is based on a conception of citizenship that rests on a neutral and impartial relationship between the state and the individual. Citizenship, as we know, actually reflects an inherent tension. It is a status that both includes and excludes. Citizenship is a concept with both internal and external boundaries. In fact, it conceals existing inequalities.


The demand for equal citizenship alone is not enough. In an environment where rights and freedoms are being curtailed, public spaces are increasingly shrinking, and various forms of exclusion are being created, is equal citizenship sufficient? What we actually need is equal citizenship plus rights.”


Füsun Üstel pointed out that the demand for equal citizenship must also be critically examined from the perspective of women. She continued: “What does equal citizenship mean for women? Is the concept of equal citizenship broad enough to include women? Behind equal citizenship lie masculine norms, patriarchal structures, and hierarchies. At the local level, we are facing a major backlash against women. At the global level, we are also witnessing an alliance of right-wing, conservative, and authoritarian regimes against women. Therefore, we must not be content with the demand for equal citizenship alone. We can bring these issues to the forefront by discussing them as part of building peace and a democratic society.”


Gültan Kışanak: Freedom does not come with permission


Speaking after, Gültan Kışanak stated the following:


“Freedom is something that begins and ends with us. Freedom is not a space that opens up with the permission of those in power or of men. If you do not take action yourself, it will never happen. We cannot achieve equal citizenship without dismantling the patriarchal, capitalist, and colonialist system.


When it comes to equal citizenship, simply putting race, class, and gender into words is not enough. We have often discussed how the Kurdish question also stems from our inability to become ‘us.’ We believe that differences have points of intersection and that, by developing policies on this common ground, we can build our shared future. We will succeed.”


Hidayet Şefkatli Tuksal: We should focus more on what unites us than what divides us


Feminist writer Hidayet Şefkatli Tuksal emphasized that the women’s movement and the Kurdish women’s movement have been struggling together against policies of repression and violence targeting women in Turkey.

title: Süper Lig 10'uncu hafta maçı: Erzurumspor FK kendi evinde Çorumspor'a farklı yenildi
content:
Süper Lig'in 10’uncu hafta maçında Erzurumspor FK. Kendi evinde Çorumspor’a 3-1 yenildi

20. dakikada konuk ekip öne geçti. Paslaşarak kullanılan duran topun devamında ceza sahasına doğru yapılan ortayı savunma karşıladı. Orta yuvarlağın önüne doğru açılan topu Cengiz Ünder kale alanı sol çaprazına doğru tekrar ortaladı. O bölgede kendini boşa çıkaran Çağlar Söyüncü, sağ ayağının içiyle yaptığı vuruşta meşin yuvarlak uzak direğin dibinden ağlara gitti: 0-1.

32. dakikada kendi yarı alanından paslaşarak çıkan konuk ekipte Cengiz Ünder, sağ kanattan içeri katederek topu ters kanattaki Kyziridis'e aktardı. Bu futbolcunun uzak köşeye gönderdiği şutta meşin yuvarlak yandan auta çıktı.

42. dakikada ev sahibi ekipte Orhan Ovacıklı'nın sağ kanattan ceza sahasına gönderdiği ortada topla buluşan Giorbelidze, ceza sahası ön çizgisinden yakın köşeye sert vurdu. Kaleci Felipe, gole izin vermeyerek son anda uzandığı topu kornere çeldi.

Karşılaşmanın ilk yarısı Çorum FK'nin 1-0 üstünlüğüyle sona erdi.

55. dakikada ev sahibi ekipte Orhan Ovacıklı'nın sağ kanattan ceza sahasına gönderdiği ortada Giorbelidze, kale alanında kafa vuruşunu yaptı. Kaleci Felipe, yakın mesafeden üzerine gelen topu kontrol ederek gole izin vermedi.

71. dakikada sol kanada gönderilen pasta araya giren Gerxhaliu, meşin yuvarlağı kalecisi Ertuğrul Taşkıran'a aktardı. Ertuğrul'un bekletmeden uzaklaştırmak istediği top kısa düştü. Ceza sahası önünde meşin yuvarlağı önünde bulan Ramirez, kaleciyle karşı karşıya kaldığı pozisyonda yaptığı vuruşla topu ağlara gönderdi: 0-2.

74. dakikada ev sahibi ekip farkı bire indirdi. Rakip kalede baskısını artıran ev sahibi takımda Kerk'in savunma arkasına gönderdiği pasla topla buluşan Diabate, ceza sahasının çaprazından yaptığı sert vuruşla meşin yuvarlağı ağlarla buluşturdu: 1-2.

79. dakikada konuk ekip farkı tekrar ikiye çıkardı. Ramadani'nin sağ kanattan ceza sahasına gönderdiği ortada Orhan Ovacıklı'nın müdahalesinde topun eline çarptığı gerekçesiyle konuk ekip penaltı bekledi. title: Özgür Çelik'ten Bakırköy operasyonuna tepki
content:
İktidarın muhalefet belediyelerine yönelik operasyonları kapsamında Bakırköy Belediyesi soruşturmasında 20'si belediye görevlisi 39 kişinin tutuklanmasının ardından Yeni Parti İstanbul İl Başkanı Özgür Çelik bir açıklama yaptı. Operasyonları siyasi olarak niteleyen Çelik, "Yandaşlara, vurgunlarla zenginleşenlere dokunmayanlar, söz konusu muhalifler olunca peşinen cezaevine gönderiyor" dedi.

Özgür Çelik sosyal medya hesabından yaptığı açıklamada şu ifadelere yer verdi:

"Bakırköy Belediyemize gerçekleştirilen siyasi operasyonlar ile yeri yurdu belli olan, yıllarca devlete ve halka hizmet etmiş belediye çalışanları ve bürokratlar tutuklandı.

Yandaşlara, vurgunlarla zenginleşenlere dokunmayanlar, söz konusu muhalifler olunca peşinen cezaevine gönderiyor. Tükenmiş iktidarın kurduğu ikili hukuk düzeninde, yargıyı elinde oyuncağa çevirenlerin yürüttüğü süreçlerden adalet de hukuk da çıkmadığını milletimiz görüyor. Elbet, bu zorbalık dönemi son bulacak.

Ayşegül Başkanımızın, meclis üyelerimizin, bürokratlarımızın ve tüm yol arkadaşlarımızın yanındayız. Cennet ülkemizde cehennemi yaşatmaya, milyonların nefesini kesmeye çalışanlara izin vermeyeceğiz. Halkın yanında olanlar kazanacak, güzel Türkiye’miz yeniden nefes alacak."

author: Annady Borges
title: Pantanal entra oficialmente na rota da aridez, aponta plano do governo
content:
Os municípios de Corumbá e Ladário, no estado de Mato Grosso do Sul (MS), foram reclassificados na categoria de clima subúmido seco pelo Plano de Ação Brasileiro de Combate à Desertificação e Mitigação dos Efeitos da Seca (PAB-Brasil, 2025-2045), do Ministério do Meio Ambiente e Mudança do Clima (MMA), lançado este ano. As cidades ficam localizadas na região noroeste do estado, em uma área dominada pelo bioma Pantanal. Anteriormente, as cidades eram classificadas como de clima úmido.


O PAB é o principal instrumento de planejamento, gestão e monitoramento da Política Nacional de Combate à Desertificação (

PNCD

) para os próximos 20 anos. Elaborado por meio de processo participativo, o plano integrou saberes acadêmicos e populares. Seu objetivo é promover a recuperação socioambiental e econômica de áreas afetadas, reduzir vulnerabilidades e fortalecer a resiliência das populações mais vulneráveis.


Segundo descrito no PAB, até então, essa classificação de clima subúmido seco só havia sido registrada no interior da região Nordeste, ao norte de Minas Gerais e no noroeste do Espírito Santo. Os dados são uma atualização do último PAB, publicado em 2004. Apesar do plano ter sido lançado em junho 2026, uma

nota técnica

 do Instituto Nacional de Pesquisas Espaciais (Inpe), em conjunto com o Centro Nacional de Monitoramento e Alertas de Desastres Naturais (Cemaden), divulgada em 2023, também já havia revelado o aumento da aridez nesta região de Mato Grosso do Sul.


Para compreender por que uma região é classificada como subúmida seca, é necessário considerar o Índice de Aridez (IA). Ele é calculado pela razão entre a chuva acumulada em uma região e a evapotranspiração potencial do mesmo período, isto é, quanta água a atmosfera demandaria das plantas e do solo se houvesse disponibilidade suficiente. Quanto menor esse número, mais seco é o clima, porque a demanda de água supera o volume de chuva.


A partir dele, os pesquisadores classificam o clima em três faixas: árido (abaixo de 0,2), semiárido (entre 0,2 e 0,5) e subúmido seco (entre 0,5 e 0,65). Foi nessa última faixa que passaram a se enquadrar Corumbá e Ladário, de acordo com os dados analisados para o período entre 1990 e 2020, na bacia do Rio Paraguai.


Sobre Corumbá e Ladário


Corumbá tem cerca de 96.334 habitantes, segundo dados do IBGE, e é o quinto município mais populoso de Mato Grosso do Sul. A economia local tem forte presença do agronegócio e, de acordo com a Embrapa, a pecuária de corte é a base da economia rural do município. Corumbá abriga um rebanho bovino com mais de 2,1 milhões de cabeças de gado.


Em Ladário, por sua vez, a agricultura familiar e de subsistência tem destaque na produção agrícola, diferentemente do modelo de agronegócio exportador de grãos, como soja e milho, predominante em outras regiões do estado.


Segundo a prefeitura, a produção agrícola se concentra em pequenas propriedades e assentamentos rurais, como o Assentamento 72, que abriga uma

comunidade “tradicional pantaneira”

.


Os dois municípios fazem divisa, e Ladário é um enclave territorial, ou seja, está completamente cercado por Corumbá. As cidades também são próximas geograficamente, com cerca de 6 quilômetros entre seus centros urbanos, e mantêm uma forte integração econômica e urbana.


O que o Cerrado tem a ver com isso?


Apesar de o PAB mencionar que a região afetada é do bioma Pantanal, a Mongabay conversou com Gabriel Hofmann, geógrafo e pesquisador da Plataforma Internacional para Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação em Saúde (Pictis), sobre fenômenos observados no Cerrado que ajudam a explicar as mudanças na disponibilidade de água que também afetam o Pantanal.


Hofmann é autor, junto com outros pesquisadores, de um estudo publicado em 2023 na

revista Scientific Reports

, intitulado, em tradução livre, “Alterações na circulação atmosférica e na evapotranspiração estão reduzindo a precipitação no Cerrado brasileiro”.


Segundo o especialista, a seca no Cerrado está diretamente ligada ao fortalecimento e à expansão do anticiclone do Atlântico Sul, sistema de alta pressão responsável pela estiagem natural do Centro-Oeste, que vem se intensificando com as mudanças climáticas e empurrando o fim do período seco para outubro e até novembro.


“A mudança climática está levando a uma intensificação desse sistema, ou seja, ele está ficando cada vez mais fortalecido, mais forte, e está se expandindo mais para o sul, ampliando a área de atuação no hemisfério sul”, afirma …

author: Unknown
title: Kêşeya kurd an kêşeya kurdî
content:
Bi salan e em vê peyva “Kürt Sorunu” anku “Kêşeya kurd” dibihîzin, hinek dibêjin kêşeya kurd di rastîya xwe de kêşeya kurdî ye, ew jî ber qedexekirina zimanê kurdî ye. Hinek jî ya rast kêşe ne kurd in, ne jî kurdî ye, kêşe ew tirk in ku naxwazin dest ji serdestîya xwe berdin. 


Ji bo deshilatîya Tirkiyeyê kurd çima kêşe û arîşe ne? Ji ber ku ew naxwazin dev ji ziman, çand û nasnameya xwe berdin, ew dixwazin li ser xaka xwe bi nasnameya xwe bijîn. Lê dema ku mirov bi baldarî lê dinêre, kêşe ew modela netewe-dewletê ye ku bi darê zorê li ser gelan hatiye ferzkirin. Bi wê modelê re yekdengî û yekrengî li ser civakê hatiye ferzkirin. 


Hinek berdevkên desthilatîyê dibêjin, kurd jixwe tu carî nebûne dewlet. Ev gotin hem rast e, hem jî ne rast e. Heta pêşketina îdeolojîya netewegirîyê, ne netewe (bi wateya xwe ya rasteqîn) hebûn, ne jî netewe-dewlet hebûn. Em bi hûrbînî bala xwe bidinê, Osmanî jî ne dewleteke tirkan bû. Heke dewleteke tirkan bûya, rayedarên wê nedigot, “Etrakê bî îdrak”.


Li alîyê din, heke em van dewletên ku şah û padîşahên wan ji regezeke tirk in, wekî dewletên tirkan bipejirînin, hingî dewleta Eyûbî, dewleta Merwanî, dewleta Şedadî jî dewletên kurdan in. Ewên ku bi deh hezar leşkerî çûn hawara Alparslan Merwanî bûn. Piştî wê jî kurd heta Fermana Tanzîmatê di bin serwerîya mîrekîyên xwe de nîv-serbixwe dijiyan; bi tenê bac û leşker didan dewleta Osmanî. 


Her wekî hemû dewletên îslamî, Împaratorîya Osmanî jî dewleteke misilmananbû, miletê misilman bi hemû pêkhateyan xwe serwer û serdest bûn. Mixabin miletê ne-misilman jî bindest bûn.  Hingî kurdên êzîdî ne tê de, kurd jî ji miletê misilmanbûn û serdest bûn.


Têkilîya kurd û tirkan piştî ku jon-tirk hatin ser desthilatîyê û tirkperestî li ser miletê misilman ferz kirin xera bûn. Îdeolojîya tirkperwerî û tirkperestîyê piştî têkçûna Osmanîyan a li Balkanan (1912) bi handana almanan geş bû. Almanya wekî hêzeke emperyalist a nû ji xwe re li nokeran digerîya, ji bo vê yekê piştgirî da turkîzmê.


Her wekî “ Îsmaîl Kupelî di gotara xwe ya bi navê “

The Kurdish Question in Turkey: On violent enforcement of nation-state (Kêşeya Kurd li Tirkiyeyê: Li ser Netewe-dewleta bi darê zorê)”

de jî bal kişandiye serê, heta sepandina polîtîkayên tirkîzmê kurd parçeyekî desthiatîyê bûn. Di destpêkê de di nav Îttîhat Terakkî de jî gelek kurdên mîna Evdila Cewdet hebûn ku di kovarên kurdan de nivîsên wî hatine weşandin. Lê sala 1909an hemû bername û plansazîyeke avakirina netewe-dewleta tirk hatiye danîn û piştî wê hemû sazî û dezgehên ne-tirkperest hatine qedexekirin. Pêşeng û rewşenbîrên kurdan piştî vê yekê bûne dijber.


Ev polîtîka û plansazîya avakirina netewe-dewleta tirk ji hêla avakarên komarê ve jî hatiye domandin. Li gorî vê bernameyê gelên ne-misilman bi awayekî ji holê hatine rakirin, ji bo gelên ne-tirk ên misilman jî biryara helandin û pişaftinê hatiye girtin. Li gorî vê bernameyê dewleta ku berê hemû misilmanan bû, êdî bi tenê dibû ya tirkan û kesên ku dibûn tirk. 


Kurdan ev polîtîka nepejirand, ji ber vê yekê tiştê ku em îro jê re dibêjin, “Kêşeya Kurd” derket holê. 


Li gorî Kupeli, bi tenê piştî Serhildana Şêx Seîd 15 hezar kes hatin kuştin, bi deh hezaran kes jî hatin mişextîkirin. Li gorî raporên dewletê di navbera salên 1925-1938an de 60 hezar kes hatin kuştin û 180 hezar kes ji cih û warê xwe hatin koçberkirin. 


Niha em qala aştî û biratîyê dikin, heke em li ser tiştan xeber nebin, wê modela netewe-dewleta ku bi darê zorê hatiye avakirin, nexin bin lêpirsînê, komareke li ser pir-dengî û pir-rengîyê ava nekin, em ê çawa li hev werin, bi hev re bijîn. . 


Her wiha heke em qala Terteleya Dêrsimê, Qirkirina Gelîyê Zîlan, Qoçgirî nekin em ê çawa xwe bigîhinin aştî û aramîyê. Bi mêjîyê ku hê jî ji me re qala “Sêva Sor” û çîrokên Turanîzmê dike re çawa li hev bikin. Ew aqlîyeta yekperest dê çawa bibe parçeyekî modela pêkvejiyana li ser pir-rengî û pirdengîyê. Helbet ne tenê divê kurd û tirk li hev werin, divê sûcên li dijî gelê alewî, gelên ne-misilman jî derkevin holê, hesabê wan sûcan (kê kiribe) were pirsin.


(ST/FY)

author: Randi Beers
title: Why were elders evicted from Tusaajiapik elders’ home?
content:
What’s going on at Kuujjuaq’s former elders’ home?


Health officials have been maddeningly vague about the building, which, until earlier this month, housed seniors and other residents in need of long-term care. 


The heat may or may not be working. The sprinkler system also apparently does not work, which may or may not be a regulatory issue. Whatever is going on, there are numerous issues with the building,

dealing

 with its “major technical components.” 


These issues cannot be addressed quickly enough for the elders to stay, said a representative with the health board this week in an email.


But apparently the building will be fine for use by the village’s homeless population

as early as

 Nov. 5.


Just weeks after health officials


moved

 elders out of Tusaajiapik elders’ home to a facility near Montreal, Nunatsiaq News found out that the building would become a


temporary homeless shelter

 as part of a one-year deal.


Kuujjuaq’s homeless population is in dire need of shelter as winter sets in, Deputy Mayor Claude Gadbois said in an interview earlier this week, as the community’s former shelter had to close in September due to mould and other critical issues.


On any given night, he said, 25 of the village’s 2,600 residents need a shelter bed.


So that leaves us wondering: Is this why the elders had to move out when they did? 


The information that’s out there creates the perception that health officials evicted elders and long-term care residents from their home and gave it to the community’s homeless population.


If heat is an issue, one would think the building is inappropriate as a living space, full stop. Officials have also pointed to changes to the provincial regulatory code that make it mandatory for elders’ residences to have working sprinkler systems, which the building lacks. But those new regulations don’t go into effect until December 2027.


To be clear, everybody deserves a roof over their head.


The situation in Kuujjuaq appears to point to a more insidious issue: infrastructure problems have gone unaddressed for so long that there is not enough space to accommodate both vulnerable groups of elders and those experiencing homelessness.


Gadbois explained that a Quebec Housing Corp. proposal for a nine-bed facility fell through four years ago because the village said it needed more than double that number of beds.


What is happening on the provincial level that allows these projects to stall because the needs on the ground are bigger than first thought?


Officials with Nunavik’s health board and Ungava Tulattavik Health Center made the call to move the elders. Despite numerous requests for interviews and more information since problems with the former elders’ home


first came to light

 in April, Nunatsiaq News has not been granted a single interview with the health board as of press time for this editorial.


The newspaper was granted an interview, last week, with the health centre.


Late this week the health board sent a short statement clarifying that the building is appropriate for residents who are “mobile” and that the heat is getting fixed. Nobody was made available to clarify why local leaders claim the heat does actually work or why the elders moved a year before the new sprinkler requirements come into effect.


However these decisions were made, it’s no doubt a sensitive issue. But a willingness to openly talk about it is necessary, because leaving the public on their own to parse contradictory information only makes matters worse.

author: anred
title: Lomas de Zamora: reclamo vecinal por obras hídricas y prevención de inundaciones
content:
Vecinas y vecinos se reunieron con representantes del municipio para exigir respuestas frente a la paralización y desinversión en obras hidráulicas y de saneamiento. Reclamaron avances en estaciones de bombeo, reservorios y sistemas de alerta temprana, ante la amenaza de nuevas inundaciones.

Por ANRed


El pasado 23 de octubre, integrantes del

Foro Hídrico y Ambiental de Lomas de Zamora

 mantuvieron una reunión con representantes del municipio para plantear una serie de reclamos vinculados con la paralización, la falta de inversión y el estado de las obras hidráulicas fundamentales para prevenir inundaciones en distintos barrios del distrito.


Uno de los principales puntos abordados fue la situación de la estación de bombeo del Arroyo del Rey, donde las organizaciones vecinales solicitaron ampliar la cantidad de bombas para mejorar la capacidad de drenaje y reducir el riesgo de anegamientos. También reclamaron la instalación de compuertas y una estación de bombeo en el Aliviador Oeste del Arroyo del Rey, a la altura de la calle Vucetich, con el objetivo de optimizar la circulación de los caudales y prevenir desbordamientos.


Otro de los reclamos estuvo dirigido a conocer la situación de la estación de bombeo del Arroyo Santa Catalina, cuya obra se encuentra paralizada por decisión del Gobierno Nacional. A su vez, exigieron información sobre los avances del reservorio de Llavallol, proyectado en los terrenos de la fábrica VASA, una infraestructura considerada clave para regular los excedentes de agua y disminuir el impacto de las inundaciones.


La reunión también puso sobre la mesa la necesidad de contar con un plan de contingencia y alerta temprana. Desde el Foro reclamaron protocolos claros de prevención y evacuación, junto con sistemas de alarma que permitan anticipar situaciones de emergencia, especialmente frente a los pronósticos asociados al fenómeno de El Niño. Además, se plantearon distintas demandas de infraestructura que afectan cotidianamente a barrios del municipio.


Como resultado del encuentro, las autoridades municipales del gobierno de Federico Otermin asumieron tres compromisos: gestionar una reunión entre el Ministerio de Infraestructura, el municipio y representantes del Foro Hídrico; realizar recorridas territoriales junto a la comunidad por los lugares donde se reclaman obras; e impulsar una mesa de diálogo específica para abordar el plan de contingencia y alerta temprana. También acordaron sostener reuniones de seguimiento para evaluar los temas planteados.


Más de dos décadas de organización vecinal


Desde el Foro Hídrico y Ambiental valoraron la instancia de diálogo,

pero remarcaron la necesidad de que los compromisos se traduzcan en respuestas concretas.

 La organización sostiene desde hace más de veinte años una lucha colectiva por el derecho a vivir en un ambiente saludable, sin inundaciones, contaminación ni basurales a cielo abierto, y con acceso al agua potable y a obras de saneamiento.


En un territorio donde las inundaciones se repiten y afectan las condiciones de vida de numerosas familias, la falta de infraestructura adecuada constituye una problemática que requiere políticas públicas sostenidas, inversión y planificación.


La organización comunitaria vuelve a poner en evidencia que el acceso al agua segura, el saneamiento y la prevención de inundaciones no son demandas aisladas, sino derechos esenciales que deben garantizarse. Mientras las obras continúan pendientes, vecinas y vecinos mantienen la organización y la exigencia de respuestas.
