author: David Swanson
title: How the U.S. Brought War to Ukraine
content:
By David Swanson, World BEYOND War, October 31, 2026


If there is still someone out there who has persisted until now in the idea that Ukrainian history began in 2022, and that wiser members of the U.S. establishment didn’t warn against, and more conniving members strategize for, each U.S. step toward war from the NATO enlargement of the 1990s through the U.S.-backed coup of 2014, the U.S.-backed war that began in 2014, Obama’s military training and base building, Trump’s weapons shipments, Biden’s hostility toward diplomacy, the fantastic horror fables of Russiagate, the reduction of Germany and France to mindless puppets treating the Minsk agreements as a trick, and the U.S. blocking of negotiation or peace just before and just after the Russian invasion — and if such a someone has reached a point of open-mindedness to

information

, there’s a new book that might really help.


And it sure is badly needed in this moment of Democratic candidates rising on public opposition to wars, even while promising to escalate the war in Ukraine the moment they’re able to.


But the value of this new book to me lies in how it takes the story of the Ukraine War back, not just to the 1990s but to the 1940s. In

Boiling Point: How America Brought War to Ukraine,

Stephen Kinzer gives us deeper understanding of roots and motivations, establishing beyond any possible dispute that the U.S. government began a project of using Ukraine to weaken Russia and pursued it across generations, through changes in individual actors, through failure after failure, and through U.S. presidents who themselves may have lacked a decent understanding of the project they were continuing — so that, as open hostility toward the Soviet Union became supposed friendliness toward Russia, the public face of obliviousness regarding Russia’s inscrutable opposition to the unchanging project of bringing Ukraine into NATO may in fact have involved some actual obliviousness.


Kinzer opens his book claiming to be presenting just the facts, ma’am, and to in no sense be denying the role that Ukrainians have played in their own history. He takes no position on Russia’s criminal and murderous actions, but simply includes them as part of the story. Nonetheless, it is a story of a major project aimed at influencing Ukraine and Russia from Washington, Langley, and Manhattan — sometimes secretly, for example by parachuting would-be revolutionaries into Ukraine to meet their deaths, and sometimes openly, for example celebrating U.S. efforts to interfere in a Russian election to ensure that a drunken buffoon remain in charge of Russia. Even the interference in Ukraine during the eight years leading up to 2022 was generally a point of pride to be openly bragged about right up until it wasn’t. Not just U.S. officials like Victoria Nuland but private foundations such as George Soros’ couldn’t help crowing about how much they’d spent and how responsible they were for overthrowing and manipulating the government of Ukraine. Even now, Nuland goes on camera and openly admits to the U.S. blocking of a peace agreement just weeks after the Russian invasion, and NATO’s top officials can’t stop themselves from pointing out that the insistence on NATO membership was the cause of the war. But the rest of us aren’t supposed to repeat these things.


In Ukraine we have polls now showing large majority support for compromising and ending the war, whereas for a couple of years we we badgered with our supposed responsibility to risk nuclear apocalypse because Ukrainians wanted it. The story of U.S. government behavior from the 1940s on, during which the desires of Ukrainians mattered to U.S. policy makers exactly never, makes clear what an odd and fleeting pretense it was to claim that keeping Ukraine at war was a sacred duty to the people of Ukraine who were insisting upon it.


When World War II ended and the U.S. government was able to jump right back to treating the Soviet Union as its primary enemy, some in the incipient U.S. spy-sabotage-assassination complex that would become the CIA saw Ukraine as the most powerful tool available to threaten Russia, just as Russia saw Ukraine as the pathway for a threatening invasion. Frank Wisner was an early driving force. He would witness a murderous Soviet takeover in Romania. Other key individuals over the decades would themselves or their families have histories of resentment toward Russia. Stalin had starved millions. Soviets had abused and …

title: Kadınlar Ankara’da barış, demokrasi ve eşitliği konuşuyor
content:
“Kadınlar Yan Yana Geleceği Konuşuyor” konferansı, Ankara’da başladı.


Yaklaşık iki aylık hazırlığın ardından düzenlenen konferans için gazeteci, yazar, akademisyen, siyasetçi ve aktivistlerin de aralarında bulunduğu 80 kadın çağrı yaptı. Buluşmaya 500’den fazla kadının katılması bekleniyor.


31 Ekim-1 Kasım tarihlerindeki konferansta kadınların kendi gündemleri ve sorunlarının yanı sıra barış, adalet, demokrasi, eşit yurttaşlık, toplumsal cinsiyet eşitliği ve örgütlenme özgürlüğü ele alınacak.


Konferans, müzisyen İlkay Akkaya’nın dinletisiyle başladı. İlk oturumun başlığı “Özgürlükler, demokrasi, adalet ve eşit yurttaşlık” olarak belirlendi.


Oturumda Gültan Kışanak, Barışa İhtiyacım Var Kadın İnisiyatifi’nden Feride Eralp, Zeynep Altıok Akatlı, Hidayet Şefkatli Tuksal ve siyaset bilimci Füsun Üstel konuşacak.


Bugün toplumsal cinsiyet ve özgürlükler konuşulacak


Konferansın bugünkü programı, “Kapitalizme ve sömürüye karşı emek mücadelesini konuşuyoruz” başlıklı forumla devam edecek.


Günün son oturumunda ise “Toplumsal cinsiyet eşitliği ve özgürlük mücadelesini konuşuyoruz” başlığı altında katılımcılar bir araya gelecek. İlk gün programı saat 18.30’daki kapanışla sona erecek.


Kadınlar barışı nasıl tanımlıyor: “Yan yanayız, geleceği konuşuyoruz”


26 Ekim 2026


Yarın barış, siyaset ve ekoloji gündemde


Konferansın ikinci günü, “Barışın siyasal sorumluluğu; demokratik çözüm, Meclis ve siyasi partiler” başlıklı oturumla başlayacak.


Oturumda CHP’den Gökçe Gökçen, DEM Parti’den Pervin Buldan ve Yeni Yol’dan Sema Silkin Ün konuşmacı olarak yer alacak.


İkinci günün öğleden sonraki bölümünde “Doğanın ve yaşamın özgürleştirilmesi mücadelesini konuşuyoruz” başlıklı forum düzenlenecek.


Konferans, “Barış ve adalet mücadelesini konuşuyoruz” başlıklı son forumun ardından saat 18.30’da sona erecek.


Kandıra Cezaevi’nde tutuklu bulunan eski HDP Eş Genel Başkanı Figen Yüksekdağ’ın mesajı da konferansta okunacak.


Konferans sonunda ortak bir sonuç bildirgesi yayımlanması planlanmıyor. Organizatörler bunun yerine kadınların sorunlarını, taleplerini ve çözüm önerilerini birlikte tartışmasını amaçlıyor.

author: Unknown
title: The Kurdistan Region’s experience of government – II
content:
The expected outcome did not materialise following the elections of 20 October 2024. The two dominant political forces, the Kurdistan Democratic Party (KDP) and the Patriotic Union of Kurdistan (PUK), continue to insist on their respective demands. In this part of our series, we examine the government formation crises that have become all too familiar to the people of Southern Kurdistan (Başûr), their causes and the price paid for them.


Deadlocks from the first cabinet to the latest


Each crisis began with a different development, but all reached a deadlock over the same three issues: who would control the region's revenues, who would command the armed forces and intelligence services, and whether the two major parties would be represented equally or according to their parliamentary seats. In 1994, these disputes escalated into war; in 2015, they led to the closure of parliament; and after 2024, they resulted in a prolonged political deadlock.


First cabinet:

The government was formed on 4 July 1992, 46 days after the elections of 19 May 1992. During this period, efforts were made to overcome allegations of electoral fraud and disagreements over equal representation, with 50 seats for each party.


Fifth cabinet:

 Following the elections of 30 January 2005, disagreements over the unification of the two administrations and the regional presidency delayed the formation of a new government for 462 days, until 7 May 2006.


Sixth cabinet:

 The government was formed on 28 October 2009, 95 days after the elections of 25 July 2009, following disputes over the transfer of the premiership to the PUK.


Eighth cabinet:

 The emergence of the Gorran Movement and the reduction in the PUK's parliamentary representation following the elections of 21 September 2013 led to a deadlock that was resolved after 270 days. The cabinet was formed on 18 June 2014.


Ninth cabinet:

Following the elections of 30 September 2018, the end of equal representation and disagreements over the Kurdistan Region's ministerial legislation delayed the formation of the cabinet for 283 days, until 10 July 2019.


Tenth cabinet:

More than two years after the elections of 20 October 2024, the Kurdistan Region's tenth cabinet has still not been formed because of disputes over the allocation of ministries and equal representation.


First cabinet: Equal representation, 50–50


The region's first government crisis began before the polls had even closed. Smaller parties accused the two major parties of multiple voting, while the KDP and PUK also accused each other of electoral irregularities. It was announced that 70 per cent of the problems had been caused by erasable ink. The initial count gave the KDP 51 seats and the PUK 49. The outcome was settled through three days of closed-door negotiations between the party leaders, after which the KDP relinquished one seat. The second round of the leadership election was also postponed and ultimately never held. As a result, the region had no elected president until 2005.


Under the 50–50 arrangement, every minister had a deputy from the rival party. The Director General of Public Security was from the KDP, while the Director General of Police was from the PUK. Of the supposedly unified 35,000-strong peshmerga force, 15,000 fighters belonged to each party. Real authority rested not with the elected parliament but with the political bureaux headed by Barzani and Talabani.


The government was established at a time when United Nations (UN) sanctions against Iraq coincided with Baghdad's embargo on the Kurdistan Region. The Ibrahim Khalil (Habur) border crossing on the Turkish border became the government's main source of revenue. From 1994 onwards, the KDP stopped transferring this revenue, which amounted to approximately $35 million annually, to the government. What the two parties were dividing was not a state but a shrinking pool of revenue. The civil war was fought over the terms of that division.


Civil war: 1994–1998


The KDP-PUK war began in Qaladiza (Qeladizê) on 1 May 1994. A total of 100 people from both sides were killed during May. Approximately 500 people lost their lives in clashes in Erbil (Hewlêr) in January 1995, and the city came under PUK control. By July 1995, the KDP controlled one-third of the territory and population, while the PUK controlled the remaining two-thirds. Parliament convened for the last time in May 1995.


The KDP-PUK civil war ended through mediation by the United States …

author: Unknown
title: Iranian regime sentences Kurdish academic to nine years in prison
content:
The Iranian regime’s policies of repression and intimidation targeting the Kurdish population in Rojhilatê Kurdistan continue. Nebî Ûmêd, a university lecturer from the city of Malekshahi (Malekşahî), has been sentenced to nine years in prison for supporting protests held previously.


According to Kolber News, Branch One of the Ilam Province Court of Appeal charged Nebî Ûmêd with “acting against national security, organising gatherings and plotting against national security, and engaging in propaganda against the regime”. The court ruled that five years of his nine-year prison sentence must be served.


The violations of Nebî Ûmêd’s rights have not been limited to his prison sentence. He has been dismissed from his position at Payam Noor University, banned from leaving the country, had his passport confiscated and been prohibited from entering his hometown of Malekşahî.


Nebî Ûmêd is still living in Ilam and has not been allowed to return to his hometown.

author: Unknown
title: Prof. Birdal: A system reliant on constant inflows was bound to collapse
content:
The repercussions of the investment fund fraud scandal, which also involves politicians from the Justice and Development Party (AKP), continue, while losses suffered by people seeking to invest their savings and fluctuations in the markets remain subjects of debate.


Professor Murat Birdal, an academic in the Department of Economics at Istanbul University, spoke to ANF about the causes of the fund crisis and its economic consequences.


‘The collapse in gold prices increased interest in funds’


Murat Birdal said that the fund crisis was linked to high inflation in Turkey, explaining that people had turned to investment funds to protect and increase the value of their savings. Birdal noted that savers had sought alternative investment instruments in response to high inflation and described how the situation developed.


Birdal said: "The main issue here is that people were trying to find ways to protect their savings against high inflation. Initially, deposit interest rates were very high, and people directed their money into bank deposits. As interest rates began to fall, people turned to instruments outside the Turkish lira, such as gold. However, when gold prices plummeted, interest in investment funds increased significantly.


Some of these funds are money market funds. They invest in relatively safer instruments such as Treasury bonds, corporate debt securities and reverse repurchase agreements. Others are unrestricted funds or equity funds. These funds were able to generate returns above interest rates through investments in shares.


In the case of the funds currently under scrutiny, investments in smaller companies outside the BIST 30 and BIST 100 indices were used to drive up share prices sharply. Some shares were even used as collateral after entering the BIST 30 and BIST 100 indices, allowing loans to be issued through money market funds that were supposed to be risk-free. In this way, risks from the stock market were transferred to money market funds. While share prices were being artificially inflated, inflows into the fund market and the flight from the Turkish lira accelerated.


The reason this system is described as a Ponzi scheme is that the mechanism could only survive through a continuous inflow of new money. The moment those inflows stopped, the system would collapse. When speculative movements in share prices began destabilising the market, Morgan Stanley issued a warning in June. Mehmet Şimşek had also previously spoken about the situation. The warning raised the risk of Turkey being removed from the Emerging Markets Index and was repeated twice more.


The Ministry of Economy then took action and issued a Fund Guide. Under the guide, funds were given a deadline to reduce their excessive concentration in particular shares. This forced funds to sell their holdings, triggering an exit from the market. In short, the system was bound to collapse at some point. Morgan Stanley's warning and the subsequent publication of the fund guide were what pulled the pin."


‘Banks and companies established an extensive marketing network’


Birdal said that banks and companies had actively promoted investment funds through advertisements on various platforms, adding that these marketing activities had influenced people's investment decisions. 


Birdal continued: "During periods of high inflation, people increasingly seek ways to protect the short-term cash they hold. Beyond this, however, an extensive marketing network was established through banks and financial YouTube channels.


Bank deposit customers were directed towards these funds by portfolio advisers at banks. They were encouraged with claims such as, 'Instead of earning 3 per cent a month on deposits, you can earn 33 per cent here,' or 'Funds from major companies offering guaranteed returns.' Academics promoted these products on television and YouTube.


Most importantly, a narrative was created suggesting that the AKP was behind the scheme. People acted on their trust in the government and in fund managers who emphasised their connections with politicians. Ultimately, the inevitable collapse was triggered by Morgan Stanley's warning."


‘A mechanism requiring constant inflows of money was bound to collapse’


Birdal stressed that the state had been forced to intervene but had also been negligent throughout the process. 


He said: "The state had to make this intervention. If the process of removing Turkey from the Emerging Markets Index had begun …

title: Kamuran Reşîd: The greatest injustices occur in prisons
content:
Despite the steps taken by the Kurdish Freedom Movement as part of the Peace and Democratic Society Process, the Turkish government has yet to take any serious action. Human rights violations, unlawful practices and arbitrary measures in prisons continue to increase. Prisoners are being prevented from securing their release by Administrative and Observation Boards, which justify their decisions by citing "forced expressions of remorse" and claims that prisoners are "not ready to reintegrate into society". Political prisoners who have very little time remaining before their scheduled release are prevented from leaving prison through disciplinary penalties or other justifications and continue to be held behind bars.


Kamuran Reşîd, a member of the Rojava Prisoners Committee, spoke to ANF about the situation in prisons. Reşîd began by recalling that Abdullah Öcalan initiated the Peace and Democratic Society Process on 27 February 2025 and said: "The Call for Peace and a Democratic Society presents us with a new way of life, intellectually grounded in Abdullah Öcalan's ideas. Like a light, it opens the door to a new life. His call exposes the problems created by the existing global system and the deadlocks it has produced. Through this call, Abdullah Öcalan intervened in the current process of deadlock, crisis and collapse. He recognised that the existing system was no longer capable of managing the situation because a new crisis emerges every day. Crisis has now become part of everyday life.


The capitalist system can no longer respond to these problems. Although Abdullah Öcalan is imprisoned, he recognised these developments and considered intervention necessary. Rather than producing solutions to the problems of the Kurdish people and society in Kurdistan, the existing system responds through different methods each time. Sometimes through coercion, sometimes through division, and sometimes through forms of governance, it attempts to rule the Kurdish people and Kurdish identity by establishing domination and hegemony under different identities."


‘The state's approach is unacceptable’


Reşîd pointed out that no changes had been made to Abdullah Öcalan's circumstances following his call on 27 February 2025 and continued: "Not a single step has been taken towards Abdullah Öcalan's physical freedom. There has been no concrete development and no initiative has been undertaken. The state's approach is unacceptable. This approach represents a stance against both the process and Abdullah Öcalan. The determination demonstrated by Abdullah Öcalan is important to us. He wants to share his ideas freely with society. Once these ideas reach society, his original objective will have been achieved. The people must now embrace these ideas. Intellectuals and those who oppose the existing system must embrace Abdullah Öcalan's ideas. A struggle must be carried out on this basis, and his freedom must be secured.


Today, a law must be enacted to secure Abdullah Öcalan's freedom, and direct responsibility must be assumed. The Turkish state bears responsibility for this. Abdullah Öcalan's freedom is our fundamental issue. Öcalan is engaged in an intellectual struggle with the state every day to ensure that practical work can be carried out. He is conducting a very powerful struggle. He is also the one putting this work into practice. Obstacles are being created within the state's existing system. They do not want his call to be implemented on time and as required. Everyone's eyes are on Abdullah Öcalan. Everyone is asking, 'What will Abdullah Öcalan say?' He is the principal figure conducting discussions and negotiations and leading this process. Since the process began, Öcalan has conducted nothing in secret. The struggle is open and transparent. He expresses his views openly. The state has always denied us and treated us as though we did not exist. It refused to recognise the Kurdish people and Kurdistan and denied their existence. The struggle was carried out under these conditions. Many things were created out of nothing."


‘The situation of political prisoners is a serious issue’


Kamuran Reşîd, a member of the Rojava Prisoners Committee, spoke about the situation of political prisoners who have not been released from prisons in Turkey and Northern Kurdistan (Bakur), despite having completed their sentences: "The situation of our comrades held in prisons in Northern Kurdistan and Turkey is frequently raised and discussed. title: Bilmez: The right to hope is a legal right, not a privilege
content:
The political authorities' delay in taking the necessary steps regarding the Peace and Democratic Society Process has become a subject of debate. Since the process began, Kurdish political representatives and the Kurdish movement have emphasised that clarifying the status of Kurdish People's Leader Abdullah Öcalan and implementing the European Court of Human Rights (ECtHR) ruling on the right to hope are indispensable conditions for negotiations. However, tensions have arisen following indications that those sentenced before 2005 would not benefit from the Framework Law, as well as statements by Presidential Chief Adviser Mehmet Uçum that Öcalan's status as a convicted prisoner would not change and that the enforcement of his sentence would not be suspended. Ibrahim Bilmez, one of Abdullah Öcalan's lawyers, who submitted another application to the Council of Europe's Committee of Ministers last week regarding the right to hope, spoke to ANF. Bilmez emphasised that the right to hope is not a privilege but a legal right that Turkey is obliged to uphold.


‘The right to hope cannot be tied to the process’


Lawyers from Asrın Law Office also responded to statements by government representatives concerning the status of Kurdish People's Leader Abdullah Öcalan, the chief negotiator in the Peace and Democratic Society Process, and the conditions necessary for him to work freely. Ibrahim Bilmez, one of Abdullah Öcalan's lawyers, stressed that the ECtHR's 2014 ruling on the right to hope concerning his client must be considered independently of the process that has been underway for two years. Bilmez emphasised that Abdullah Öcalan has rights recognised under both Turkish and international law, but that these rights have not been granted to him. He recalled that one of the most important of these was the ECtHR's 2014 ruling on the right to hope.


Bilmez said: "The ECtHR has issued a ruling concerning the right to hope, and that ruling clearly states: 'You cannot sentence a person to imprisonment until death. If you keep someone confined within four walls without any hope of release, this constitutes a violation of Article 3 of the Convention. In other words, it amounts to torture.' Therefore, since the day this ruling was issued, it has effectively meant that Mr. Öcalan and everyone held under aggravated life sentences have been subjected to conditions amounting to torture. There is no doubt that this process must continue and reach a conclusion. It is a very important process. Ultimately, the peoples of Turkey need peace and a solution. Our client, Mr. Öcalan, also plays an important role in this process. However, linking the ruling on the right to hope concerning Mr. Öcalan to this process is not the correct approach. The right to hope is not a privilege but a legal right. Nor is this legal right limited to our client, Mr. Öcalan. It concerns everyone serving an aggravated life sentence."


‘Turkey has been evading the issue for 12 years’


Bilmez recalled that Abdullah Öcalan is one of the most important actors in the ongoing Peace and Democratic Society Process and continued: "Mr. Öcalan's position as an important actor emerged as a result of many years of great struggle and resistance. The state did not therefore decide on its own initiative to recognise Mr. Öcalan as its interlocutor. There are various reasons for this. Mr. Öcalan has the determination, strength and sincerity needed to resolve the issue. The Kurdish people and the Kurdish movement stand behind Mr. Öcalan. The state knows and sees this very well. We are therefore talking about an actor of this significance, yet we see that his rights are not being recognised. As I mentioned earlier, I am discussing this independently of the current process. Even if this process did not exist, the ECtHR ruling would still have to be implemented. We have submitted applications to the Committee of Ministers of the Council of Europe concerning the implementation of the ECtHR ruling on the principle of the right to hope. However, Turkey has failed to implement the ECtHR's ruling on the right to hope since 2014 and has continually delayed proceedings before the Committee of Ministers. Normally, Turkey should prepare and submit an action plan to the Council of Europe setting out the changes or improvements it intends to introduce regarding the right to hope. But Turkey has not implemented the right to hope for 12 years. In the action plans it has submitted so far, it has …

title: KNK Rojava: Kurds have the duty to protect Kobanê’s achievements
content:
The Rojava Representation of the Kurdistan National Congress (KNK) issued a statement to mark 1 November, World Kobanê Day.


The statement said: "On the occasion of November 1, World Kobanê Day, we, as the Rojava Representation of the Kurdistan National Congress (KNK), extend our heartfelt congratulations to the resistance fighters of Kobanê, the families of the martyrs, the YPG/YPJ fighters, and all the people of Kobanê and Rojava. The liberation of Kobanê was not merely a military victory; it was a historic, political and academic event that created a turning point in the history of the Middle East and the struggle for humanity.


Kobanê demonstrated the defeat of the nation-state paradigm and the victory of the Democratic Nation paradigm. In Kobanê, the myth surrounding the terrorist organisation ISIS, which was supported by regional and international powers, was shattered under the leadership of women. Kobanê showed that the organised will of a people is stronger than all modern weapons and large armies. Kobanê demonstrated to the world that Kurds can not only defend themselves, but can also build a democratic alternative for a new Syria and a democratic Middle East."


The statement added: "The Kobanê resistance redefined the classical theses of political science concerning the relationship between power and legitimacy. In practice, Kobanê proved that the theory of legitimate self-defence and the coexistence of peoples are not utopian ideals, but can become a living reality. The philosophy of Leader Apo transformed Kobanê into a university where humanity was taught lessons in morality, resistance and women's freedom.


In Kobanê, the world witnessed with its own eyes how Kurdish women broke free from all the constraints and restrictions imposed by a patriarchal and reactionary society. Kurdish women were no longer victims hidden away in their homes; they became commanders, fighters and symbols of freedom. They raised the cry for freedom on behalf of women across the world.


The Kurdish women who fought in the ranks of the YPJ with extraordinary courage and conviction against the brutality of ISIS stood against an organisation that was the enemy of all women, enslaving women and selling them in markets. Through their heroism, Kurdish women avenged every woman in the world who had suffered oppression, rape and murder. They did not fight only for Kobanê; they fought for every woman in the world and defended the honour of all women."


The statement continued: "The Kobanê resistance sent a message to the world: Kurds are a free people. We are a people who bow our heads to no oppression, occupation or enslavement. We will live freely on our own land, or we will become martyrs on the path to freedom. This is the message of our ancestors and our promise to future generations.


For this reason, the liberation of Kobanê was not merely the liberation of a city, but the liberation of human dignity. Today, on the anniversary of Kobanê's liberation, we reiterate once again that protecting Kobanê's achievements is the national duty of all Kurds. National unity is the guarantee of Kobanê's permanence."

author: infolibre
title: Στολάρχες και Ευρωπαϊκή οδηγία για τις πλατφόρμες
content:
Σχεδόν έναν χρόνο μετά τη δημοσίευση του άρθρου (https://infolibre.gr/2025/12/17/o-agonas-enantia-stoys-ergolavoys-machi-epiviosis-gia-toys-dianomeis/)  για τους εργολάβους στις πλατφόρμες διανομών, η κατάσταση όχι μόνο δεν έχει βελτιωθεί, αλλά όλα δείχνουν ότι έχει επιδεινωθεί.


Οι εργολαβικές επιχειρήσεις και οι πλατφόρμες συνεχίζουν να αποκομίζουν κέρδη, όλο και περισσότεροι μετανάστες μπαίνουν στον κλάδο και βρίσκονται αντιμέτωποι με συνθήκες άγριας εκμετάλλευσης, ενώ ο ρατσιστικός λόγος εναντίον τους βρίσκει όλο και περισσότερα κανάλια και μορφές διέλευσης.


Από τη μία πλευρά, έχουν γίνει εκατοντάδες καταγγελίες από τα σωματεία και οι ελεγκτικοί μηχανισμοί αντιμετωπίζουν σοβαρές δυσκολίες στην πραγματοποίηση αποτελεσματικών ελέγχων. Από την άλλη, οι πλατφόρμες συνεχίζουν να υποστηρίζουν ότι όλα είναι νόμιμα και δεν τρέχει κάστανο. Η απάντηση που δίνουν τόσο σε δημοσιεύματα (https://www.lifo.gr/articles/oi-aoratoi-nteliberades-tis-wolt-kai-toy-efood-mia-nea-manolada-exo-apo-tin-porta-soy) όσο και στα σωματεία είναι σχεδόν στερεότυπη: οι εργολαβικοί εργαζόμενοι είναι λίγοι, γίνονται έλεγχοι και, αν διαπιστωθούν παρανομίες -που, σύμφωνα με τις ίδιες, δεν διαπιστώνονται- λαμβάνονται τα απαραίτητα μέτρα.


Ας δούμε λοιπόν μερικές από τις παραβάσεις και τις καταγγελίες που κράτος και εταιρείες “δυσκολεύονται” να εντοπίσουν.


Η αστική «Μανωλάδα»


Οι εργολαβικοί διανομείς προσλαμβάνονται ως μισθωτοί, αλλά σε αρκετές περιπτώσεις αμείβονται με τρόπο που συνδέεται άμεσα με την παραγωγή τους. Ο εργολάβος παρακρατά περίπου το 25% της αμοιβής που αντιστοιχεί στις παραγγελίες που εκτελεί ο εργαζόμενος μέσω της πλατφόρμας.


Το σύστημα αμοιβής με ποσοστό δεν αποτελεί από μόνο του παράβαση, εφόσον τηρούνται οι νόμιμες αποδοχές και όλες οι υποχρεώσεις του εργοδότη. Το ζήτημα αρχίζει όταν το σύστημα αυτό χρησιμοποιείται για να μετακυλιστεί στον εργαζόμενο το επιχειρηματικό ρίσκο ή όταν, επιπλέον, ο εργαζόμενος απειλείται με χρηματική παρακράτηση επειδή δεν πέτυχε έναν αυθαίρετο στόχο.


Και εδώ αρχίζει η πραγματική εικόνα.


Παραβάσεις που άπτονται της Επιθεώρησης Εργασίας


Δηλωμένο ωράριο και πραγματική απασχόληση


Εργαζόμενοι εμφανίζονται δηλωμένοι με συγκεκριμένο ημερήσιο ωράριο, για παράδειγμα 10:00–18:00, ενώ στην πράξη εργάζονται με «ανοιχτό slot», εκτελώντας εργασία εκτός του δηλωμένου ωραρίου, χωρίς την αντίστοιχη νόμιμη δήλωση και καταγραφή.


Το αποτέλεσμα είναι προφανές: η πραγματική διάρκεια της εργασίας δεν ταυτίζεται με αυτή που εμφανίζεται στα επίσημα στοιχεία.


Μη καταβολή των νόμιμων προσαυξήσεων


Στις καταγγελίες περιλαμβάνονται περιπτώσεις μη καταβολής των προβλεπόμενων προσαυξήσεων για πρόσθετη εργασία, υπερωρίες, Κυριακές και αργίες, καθώς και για εργασία σε ημέρες πέραν του πενθημέρου, όπου αυτή πραγματοποιείται.


Δεν αρκεί να εμφανίζεται ένας εργαζόμενος ως «απασχολούμενος». Πρέπει να αμείβεται για τον πραγματικό χρόνο και τις πραγματικές συνθήκες εργασίας του.


Εργασία έξι ή και επτά ημερών


Εργαζόμενοι που εμφανίζονται ως πενθήμεροι καταγγέλλουν ότι στην πράξη εργάζονται και έκτη ή ακόμη και έβδομη ημέρα.


Απαιτείται έλεγχος των πραγματικών ημερών εργασίας, της νομιμότητας της απασχόλησης πέραν του πενθημέρου και της καταβολής όλων των προβλεπόμενων αποδοχών και προσαυξήσεων.


Η «ελαστικότητα» που φτάνει μέχρι το 13ωρο


Η δυνατότητα οργάνωσης πολύωρης εργασίας δεν μπορεί να σημαίνει ότι ο εργοδότης αφήνει τον εργαζόμενο να εργάζεται επί όσες ώρες χρειάζεται η παραγωγή, χωρίς αξιόπιστη καταγραφή, χωρίς τήρηση των περιόδων ανάπαυσης και χωρίς την τήρηση των νόμιμων προϋποθέσεων.


Σε αυτή την περίπτωση γίνεται παράβαση ακόμα και του πιο αντεργατικού νόμου που ψήφισε η παρούσα κυβέρνηση…


Αμοιβή με ποσοστό και αυθαίρετες παρακρατήσεις


Το πρόβλημα δεν είναι ότι ένας μισθωτός μπορεί να αμείβεται με ποσοστό. Το πρόβλημα είναι όταν το ποσοστό μετατρέπεται σε μηχανισμό ώστε ο εργοδότης να απαλλάσσεται από την υποχρέωση εξασφάλισης των νόμιμων αποδοχών ή όταν επιβάλλονται αυθαίρετες παρακρατήσεις.


Σε ορισμένες περιπτώσεις καταγγέλλεται ότι, εάν ο εργαζόμενος δεν πετύχει συγκεκριμένο στόχο εσόδων, απειλείται ότι θα του παρακρατηθεί χρηματικό ποσό.


Το κόστος του δικύκλου στον εργαζόμενο


Υπάρχουν επίσης καταγγελίες εργαζομένων που χρησιμοποιούν δικό τους δίκυκλο για την εργασία τους και επιβαρύνονται οι ίδιοι με καύσιμα, φθορές και κόστος χρήσης, χωρίς να λαμβάνουν τις προβλεπόμενες παροχές ή αποζημιώσεις.


Το κόστος της επιχειρηματικής δραστηριότητας δεν μπορεί να μετατρέπεται αυθαίρετα σε …

author: Alerta
title: Φωτορεπορτάζ και Κουλτούρα Βιασμού
content:
Φωτορεπορτάζ και Κουλτούρα Βιασμού


Κείμενο που λάβαμε από το Σάβα Κοκκινίδι.


Θα έμοιαζε απλό, η πολιτική πράξη μιας φεμινιστικής καταγγελίας για σεξουαλική βία και κακοποίηση, με θύτη άνδρα με υλικά προνόμια και κοινωνικό κύρος, να απαντηθεί άμεσα με το ανάλογο κοινωνικό αντίκρισμα, ανυποχώρητη στήριξη και δήλωση αλληλεγγύης – τόσο από τους χώρους όπου στεγάζονται και δραστηριοποιούνται παραβιαστές που ξεμπροστιάζονται για τον κανόνα της εξουσιαστικότητάς τους, όσο και από τον εν γένει δημόσιο λόγο, τον ειδησεογραφικό, των πολιτικών χώρων αλλά και των πολιτών. Η σεξουαλική και έμφυλη βία αποτελεί θεμελιώδη παράμετρο της συστημικής καταπίεσης που εξευτελίζει, δολοφονεί, απαξιώνει και εργαλειοποιεί τα ανθρώπινα όντα προς όφελος μιας καταστροφικής τάξης πραγμάτων, με αποκλειστικό της μέλημα την απόλαυση της καταστροφής τους, τη διαιώνιση και εντατικοποίηση της περιθωριοποίησης και υποταγής τους.


Αντ’ αυτού, η «ελληνική κοινωνία», το σύνολο των ανεγκέφαλων πατριαρχών κάθε είδους και τα σμήνη από τα αξιοθρήνητα τσιράκια τους, πυκνώνουν το σκοτάδι, τη βία, την καταδίκη, την επιβολή του πόνου.


Στις 4 Σεπτεμβρίου του 2026 δημοσιεύτηκε στον κινηματικό ιστότοπο του Indymedia ανώνυμη καταγγελία σεξουαλικής και έμφυλης βίας και κακοποίησης

1

, με θύτη ανώνυμο άνδρα, δραστηριοποιούμενο επαγγελματικά και πολιτικά στους ευρύτερους αριστερούς, αντιφασιστικούς και κινηματικούς χώρους. Η καταγγελία δεν ενέχει κατονομασμό ούτε του κατά συρροήν παραβιαστή, ούτε και του συγκεκριμένου κλάδου όπου δραστηριοποιείτο.


Εντός 24ώρων, στο φάσμα του δημόσιου λόγου και ιδίως εντός του περιβάλλοντος των μέσων κοινωνικής δικτύωσης, το όνομα συγκεκριμένου, μακρόβιου φωτορεπόρτερ διακινείτο ως αυτό που η καταγγελία αφορούσε – με έναν εν πολλοίς οχετό μισογυνισμού, σεξιστικού και επανατραυματιστικού λόγου να ακολουθεί. Αυτό που η συγκεκριμένη –και όχι μονάχα η συγκεκριμένη– καταγγελία επίσης κατέδειξε είναι το τι νοείται και προωθείται ως σεξουαλική επαφή στην κοινή, σισετεροκανονική γνώμη – η σεξουαλική επαφή είναι η εγκαθίδρυση μιας διαπροσωπικής σεξουαλικής επιβολής, μιας εξουσιαστικής σχέσης όπου το βάρος και η ευθύνη των παραβιάσεων επιρρίπτεται αποκλειστικά στο παραβιασμένο, εξαναγκασμένο άτομο. Ο βιαστής σκοτώνει – κι αν δεν σε σκότωσε, φταις που σε βίασε.


Το παρόν κείμενο, καθώς και το υποφαινόμενο φωτογραφό, δεν θα σχολιάσουν μακρόθεν την «ανταπάντηση» στην καταγγελία είτε των αστικών, θεσμικών μέσων, είτε της αυταρχικής, πυροβολημένης «αριστεράς». Τα ίδια ελεεινά τούβλα προδίδουν κάθε υποτιθέμενη αξία τους σε κάθε σκίρτημα τυραννίας και συγκεντρωτισμού που ευαγγελίζονται και δεν υπάρχει κανένας λόγος να περιμένουμε ποτέ να δράσουν απελευθερωτικά στην ανθρώπινη ανάγκη, επιθυμία και αντίσταση.


Η αναρχία, χώρος όπου κατά βάση βγήκε και στηρίχθηκε, με κάθε δυνατό μέσο, η αλληλεγγύη στην καταγγέλουσα, συλλογικοποίησε εν μέρει την οργή και τον αλληλέγγυο λόγο και δράση με την αντανακλαστική δημιουργία της Ανοιχτής Συνέλευσης Αλληλεγγύης στην Επιζώσα – και εν μέρει έμεινε επίσης σιωπηλή. Τη εξαιρέσει αντιεξουσιαστικών φεμινιστικών συλλογικοτήτων και ατομικοτήτων, του αντιθεσμικού τρανς κινήματος και κουήρ υποκειμένων, αντιρατσιστικών ομάδων και ευάριθμων συνελεύσεων κοινωνικών καταλήψεων, το μεγαλύτερο μέρος του αναρχικού κινήματος αντέδρασε στην καλύτερη των περιπτώσεων μερικά και στη χειρότερη με επικίνδυνη αδιαφορία.


Τις ίδιες εκείνες μέρες, άρχισε να διακινείται η πληροφορία πως καλείτο «ανοιχτή συζήτηση» για τις 9 Σεπτεμβρίου από την «Πρωτοβουλία Αλληλεγγύης στον Μ.» (το γράμμα που χρησιμοποιήθηκε στην ανώνυμη καταγγελία για να προσδιορίζει τον βιαστή), με το κάλεσμα να εμπεριέχει έναν γελοίο αχταρμά στερεοτυπικού κομμουνιστικού, αναρχικού και προοδευτικού λεξιλογίου

2

 – κι ως εκ τούτου να πρόκειται κατά πάσα πιθανότητα για απόπειρα αντιαναρχικής και αντιαριστερής παραπληροφόρησης από χαφιέδες νοικοκυραίους, πεταμένους δεξιούς, κοινώς απολειφάδια. Παραταύτα, η πληροφορία στάθηκε αφορμή για την άμεση συγκρότηση αντανακλαστικής παρέμβασης στην «ανοιχτή συζήτηση», με τα συντρόφια να διαμορφώνουν επί τόπου, αφότου η «συζήτηση» της «Πρωτοβουλίας στον Μ.» φαίνεται να μη διεξήγετο, την Ανοιχτή Συνέλευση Αλληλεγγύης στην Επιζώσα

3

.


Η αντίδραση του επαγγελματικού και πολιτικού κλάδου όπου το δημόσιο βλέμμα στράφηκε για ηθική βεβαίωση, για τη διασφάλιση των ανθρωπιστικών, αντισεξιστικών παραμέτρων της υπόστασης και λειτουργίας του, ο κλάδος των φωτορεπόρτερ, ήταν και παρέμεινε η πλήρης συγκάλυψη – το ξέπλυμα του φαινομένου της …

author: Fernando Evangelista
title: Idosos na urna: meus pais, de 94 e 91 anos, e a histórica eleição de Lula
content:
A cena dos meus pais, casados há 66 anos — ele tem 94, ela 91 — caminhando de mãos dadas para votar neste domingo é, para mim, a imagem inesquecível desta eleição. A mãe, aliás, logo depois do primeiro turno, previu o fenômeno que se tornaria evidente: “com esse susto, a esquerda vai acordar”. Ela perguntou se eu havia lido o texto escrito pelo pai.


Não tinha lido, fui ler: “Vivi sob o silêncio forçado da ditadura militar, vi pessoas sendo presas, torturadas e mortas. Por isso, não compactuo com quem defende esse período. Não compactuo com quem defende torturadores. Estou do lado dos direitos humanos, da justiça social e da educação.”


Meus pais, como milhões de eleitores, protagonizaram um dos momentos políticos mais importantes da história brasileira. Talvez os sociólogos do futuro tenham dificuldade de entender o que se passou nos 20 dias que separaram a votação do primeiro turno e a do segundo. O que mudou em tão pouco tempo?


Foi a estrela do retirante nordestino, nascido para contrariar — desde sempre — qualquer previsão? Foi a esquerda que saiu da Idade Média da comunicação e se apropriou das redes sociais, liderada por um ‘general’ civil?


Foi a juventude, tida como apática e indiferente, que tomou as ruas e se posicionou politicamente? Foi o povo trabalhador que sentiu o risco de retrocessos? Foi o medo do retorno do bolsonarismo à presidência o gás necessário para tirar de casa quem não votou no primeiro turno? Foi a repulsa a um candidato desprovido de propostas, compostura e caráter, suspeito de cometer vários crimes?


Foram os idosos, como os meus pais, que votaram no primeiro turno e se mobilizaram ainda mais no segundo? Como foi possível conquistar, em apenas 20 dias, 10 milhões de votos além dos obtidos no primeiro turno?”


Não sei, só sei que foi lindo e histórico.

author: Unknown
title: 19 gündür kayıp olan Selman Alkan'ın ailesi: Arama çalışmaları devam etsin
content:
İstanbul – Sultangazi ilçesinde yaşayan ve son olarak İstanbul Büyükşehir Belediyesi’ne (İBB) ait Gazi Sosyal Tesisleri’nde görülen Selman Alkan’dan 19 gündür haber alınamıyor.

Dersimli olan ve 20 yıldır İstanbul’da yaşayan Selman Alkan, 12 Ekim günü İstanbul Sultangazi’de tek başına yaşadığı evde telefonunu, özel eşyalarını ve tüm parasını bırakarak dışarı çıktı. Arkasında bıraktığı notta, “Eşyaları alın ve evi boşaltın. Bu eve geri dönmeyeceğim. Buraya nakliye ve benzeri masraflar için 108 bin lira bırakıyorum. İşsizlik maaşım bankaya yatacak” ifadelerini kullanan Alkan’ın notunu bir gün sonra bulan yakınları, Alkan için kayıp büro amirliğine başvuru yaptı.

Nisan 2021 yılında İstanbul Ağaç Peyzaj Eğitim Hizmetleri ve Hayvanat Bahçesi İşletmeciliği Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Şirketi bünyesinde çalışmaya başlayan Alkan, Mart ayında “güvenlik soruşturması” gerekçesiyle işten çıkartıldı. İşe iade talebiyle İstanbul 30’uncu İş Mahkemesi’ne başvuran Alkan’a ilişkin işe iade kararı verildi. Şirket karara itiraz ederek kararı bölge mahkemesine taşıdı.

Mezopotamya Ajansı’ndan Ceylan Şahinli’ye konuşan Alkan’ın kardeşi Özgür Alkan, başvurulardan 48 saat sonra ağabeyini arama çalışmalarının başladığını ve son olarak eski çalıştığı tesislerin kamera kayıtlarına göre Alibeyköy Barajı kenarında görüldüğünü aktardı.

İlk günlerde arama kurtarma çalışmalarına yalnızca Sultangazi Arama Kurtarma ekiplerinin katıldığını, AFAD’ın ancak günler sonra arama çalışmasına dahil olduğunu söyleyen Alkan, “AFAD görevlileri bir delil bulunmadığı gerekçesiyle 3 günlük arama çalışması ardından çalışmalarını sonlandırdı. Alkan’ı arama çalışmaları 23 Ekim’de tamamen sona erdi. Alkan'ı ailesi ve sevenleri ise aramaya devam ediyor” dedi.

Dosyanın nöbetçi savcılık tarafından yürütüldüğünü belirten Alkan, soruşturmanın detaylı yürütülmediğini düşündüklerini dile getirdi.

Ağabeyi Alkan’ın evi terk ettiğini öğrendiklerinde emniyete başvurmalarına rağmen 48 saat geçmeden işlem yapılmadığını, ardından da sel nedeniyle müdahalenin yapılmadığını söyleyen Alkan, “Kameralardan da ağabeyimin bölgeden çıkışına ya da o bölgede yürüdüğüne dair herhangi bir görüntü alamadıklarını söylediler. Şu an süreç askıda kaldı. AFAD artık çalışma yürütmüyor. Kayıp Büro ekipleri ise teknik takip ya da kamera görüntülerinin incelenmesi yoluyla abimi bulacaklarını söylüyor. Ama biz arama üzerinde çok fazla durulduğunu düşünmüyoruz” dedi.

Ağabeyi Alkan’ın çalıştığı süreç boyunca mutlu olduğunu ancak işten çıkartıldıktan sonra yaşadığı huzursuzluğu görebildiklerini söyleyen Alkan, "Ağabeyim evden ayrılmadan beş, on gün önce yine avukatını arayıp davanın sürecini sormuş. Çalışırken mutluydu, çok keyifliydi ve umutluydu. İşten çıkarıldıktan sonra ise ciddi sıkıntılar yaşadı. Hem psikolojik hem de ekonomik olarak sorunları oldu. İş bulamıyordu. Daha 46 yaşındaydı ama bu ülkede gerçekten belli işlerde belirli bir yaş grubunun altındaki kişiler tercih ediliyor. Nereye gitse yaşından dolayı işe alınamayacağını söylüyorlardı" diye konuştu.

Aramaların daha kapsamlı ve detaylı yapılması için çağrıda bulunan Alkan, aile ve sevenleri olarak yaptıkları arama çalışmalarında profesyonel desteğe ihtiyaçları olduğu için çalışmalarını uzun süre sürdüremediklerini, ağabeyini bir an önce bulmak istediklerini ifade etti.

title: Ambush on Internal Security Forces leaves one dead and two injured
content:
The Internal Security Forces personnel patrolling Syria’s coastal region were targeted by armed individuals.

In a written statement, the General Directorate of Ports and Customs announced that one of its customs patrols had been targeted in an armed ambush.

The statement confirmed that one person was killed, and two others were injured.

title: İki GSM operatörüne yanıltıcı 5G reklamı nedeniyle 8 milyon TL'ye yakın ceza
content:
Ticaret Bakanlığı Basın ve Halkla İlişkiler Müşaviri Bekir Kaplan, GSM şebekelerinin yanıltıcı 5G reklamlarının durdurulmasına karar verildiğini ve iki GSM şebekesine 8 milyon TL’ye yakın ceza uygulandığını açıkladı.

Ticaret Bakanlığı Basın ve Halkla İlişkiler Müşaviri Bekir Kaplan, sanal medya hesabından yaptığı paylaşımda şu ifadeleri kullandı:

“Ticaret Bakanlığımız bünyesinde faaliyet gösteren Reklam Kurulu, 10 Eylül 2026 tarihli 373 sayılı toplantısında, tüketicileri yanıltıcı nitelikteki 5G reklamlarına yönelik incelemeleri sonucunda iki GSM ve telekomünikasyon şirketine yaptırım uyguladı. İncelemelerde; 5G hizmetinin kapsama alanı ve teknolojik üstünlüğüne ilişkin gerçeği aşan, tüketicilerde mutlak üstünlük algısı oluşturan iddialara yer verildiği, ayrıca henüz ticari olarak kullanıma açılmamış 5G teknolojisinin kampanya avantajlarıyla ilişkilendirilerek tüketicilerin yanıltılabileceği tespit edildi. Bu kapsamda, iki şirkete toplam 7 milyon 983 bin 304 TL idari para cezası uygulanmasına ve ilgili reklamların durdurulmasına karar verildi. Ticaret Bakanlığımız; tüketicilerin doğru, açık ve eksiksiz bilgilendirilmesini sağlamak, yanıltıcı reklamlarla haksız rekabetin önüne geçmek ve tüketici haklarını korumak amacıyla denetim ve yaptırım faaliyetlerini kararlılıkla sürdürmektedir.”

author: Unknown
title: Vê hefteyê di biamag kurdiyê de
content:
biamaga kurdî ya vê mehê bi edîtoriya Aren Yıldırım û Ferhat Yaşar hatiye amadekirin. biamag kurdî bi gotar, hevpeyvîn û analîzên akademîk û tematîk li benda we ye.


Rûpelek nû ji bo bianet kurdiyê: biamag kurdî


5 Îlon 2026


biamag kurdî ya vê mehê; ji nêrînên li ser paradîgmaya Abdullah Ocalan bigirin heta zextên bazarê yên li ser muzîkjenên serbixwe, ji lêkolîna li ser fîlma "Bêdengî"yê heta diyalogên germ ên hevaltiyê yên Xêro û Elîko, ji kûrahiya lîrîzma helbestkariya Seydayê Tîrêj heta wateya siyasî û nasnameyî ya Amedsporê, ji psîkolojiya civakên zordar bigirin heta pirsên li ser derew û azadiyê, ji têkiliya navbera mirov û pergalên siyasî bigirin heta keşfên girîng ên fîzîkê, ji rola Pêşbirka Helbestê ya Arjen Arî ya di dewlemendkirina helbesta kurmancî de bigirin heta sedemên derketina kêşay Kurd, van hemû babetan di nava xwe de dihewîne.


Nivîs û naverokên vê mehê weha ne:


Ozgur Amed

di vê analîza xwe de cudahiya di navbera nêrîna ramangerên cîhanî û nîqaşên li Tirkiyeyê yên derbarê paradîgma û nêrîna Abdullah Ocalan de radixe ber çavan. Amed dibêje ku fîlozofên navdar ên cîhanê yên weke Slavoj Žižek, Gayatri Spivak û Franco “Bifo” Berardi, Ocalan wekî ramangerekî ku ekolojî, azadiya jinê û demokrasiyê esas digire, dinirxînin. Her wiha Amed rexne li wê yekê jî digire ku ev guherîna fikirî li qada navneteweyî bi berfirehî tê nîqaşkirin, lêbelê li Tirkiyeyê mixabin ev mesele tenê di çarçoveyeke teng a ewlehî û pevçûnê de tê girtin.


Dilşah Kaymaz

 di nivîsa xwe ya vê mehê de behsa zehmetiyên aborî û zextên bazarê yên muzîkjenên serbixwe rûbirû dibin dike. Kaymaz dibêje ku ev yek di heman demê de azadiya wan a hunerî û domandina berhemên bi zimanên kêmneteweyan jî dixin xeterê. Her weha Kaymaz balê dikişîne ser wê yekê ku divê nirxa muzîkê ne bi hejmarên guhdarîkirinê, bi girîngiya wê ya çandî were pîvan û parastina wê wekî berpirsiyariyeke civakî bê dîtin.


Xecê Rêdûr

bi analîza fîlma bi navê “Bêdengî(Silence)”yê  li pêşberî xwîneran e. Rêdûr filmê di çarçoveya exlaq, tirs û tundkariyê de şîrove dike.


Dilşêr Bêwar

 di nivîsa xwe ya vê mehê de bi zimanekî germ û samîmî rasterast mevanê malên xwendevanan e. Bêwar têkiliya nêzîk û jidil a di navbera du hevalan (Xêro û Elîko) de bi hunermendî hûnandiye. Her wiha bi rêya van dîmenên sade yên gundewarî, rengê jiyana civakî û durustiya têkiliyên mirovî aniye ziman.


Siya Robîn

 di nivîsa xwe de balê dikişîne ser rola girîng a hunera Seyda Tîrêj a di çand û wêjeya kurdî de. Her wiha Robîn mîrateya helbestkariyê ya Tîrêj ji aliyê teknîkî, lîrîzm û naverokê ve dinirxîne û qala hêmanên xwezayî û civakî-neteweyî yên di berhemên wî de dike.


Mehmet Erbey

di gotara xwe ya vê mehê de behsa rola civakî û siyasî ya Amedsporê dike. Erbey her wiha tîne ziman ku Amedspor ji bo Kurdan ne tenê tîmeke werzişê ye, di heman demê de veguheriye qadeke nasnameyî û nûnertiyê


Mazhar Rojava

 di nivîsa xwe de behsa pêwendiya di navbera derew, azadî û pergalên siyasî de dike û her wiha li ser psîkolojiya mirovên ku di nava civakên zordar an jî demokratîk de dijîn, radiweste.


Ayşenur Özel

ê di gotara xwe ya vê mehê de qala sedema bidestxistina Xelata Nobelê ya Fîzîkê ji aliyê fîzîknas Francis Halzen ve û girîngiya notrînoyên enerjiya bilind kiriye.


Bêrîvan Kayi

yê jî di nivîsa xwe de girîngî û rola Pêşbirka Helbestê ya Arjen Arî ya di pêşvebirin û dewlemendkirina helbesta kurmancî de ji bo xwendevanan dinirxîne.


Sami Tan

 di gotara xwe ya vê mehê de behsa kêşeya Kurd dike û sedemên dîrokî û siyasî yên derketina “Kêşeya Kurd” radixe ber çavan.


Pêşniyara guhdarkirinê ya vê hefteyê

author: Unknown
title: Xelata Nobelê ya Fîzîkê ji bo Notrînoyên Enerjiya Bilind
content:
Akademiya Zanistî ya Qraliyetê ya Swêdê ragihand ku Xelata Nobelê ya Fîzîkê ya sala 2026an ji Francis Halzen re hatiye dayîn. Hate ragihandin ku ev fîzîknasê Belçîkî yê li Zanîngeha Wisconsin-Madison dixebite, ji ber tevkariyên wî yên girîng di avakirina Çavdêrxaneya Nêtrîno ya IceCube de li Cemserê Başûr û vedîtina notrînoyên enerjiya bilind ên bi çavkaniya astrofîzîkî, layiqî vê xelatê bûye.


Notrîno di nav parçeyên jêrzemîn ên ku em nas dikin de, ji parçeyên herî dijwar ên ji bo tesbîtkirinê ne. Ev parçeyên bêbar û xwedî giraniya pir kêm, dikarin bêyî ku bi tiştekî re têkiliyê deynin, rêyên pir dirêj bibirin. Wisa ye ku dema hûn van rêzan dixwînin, bêyî ku hûn pê haydar bin, di her santîmetre çargoşeya laşê we re bi mîlyaran notrîno derbas dibin ku ji tavê belav dibin.


Francis Halzen di salên 1980î de, ramana avakirina dedektoreke notrîno di nav cemedên Cemserê Başûr de pêşniyar kir. Dema notrîno bi navokên atomê re li hev dikevin, ronahiyekê derdixin. Şefafbûna avê jî dikir ku ev ronahî hêsantir were tesbîtkirin. Her wiha, li Cemserê Başûr faktorên ku dikarin bandorê li ser encamên ceribandinan bikin, li gorî deverên din pir kêmtir bûn.


Ramanên Halzen ji aliyê fîzîknasên din ve jî piştgirî dîtin. Di nav çend salan de, ji bo avakirina dedektora yekem ceribandin dest pê kirin. Ji bo ku notrîno werin tesbîtkirin, dedektoreke pir mezin û berfireh pêwîst bû. Avakirina dedektora bi navê IceCube, ku di qada yek kîlometreya kubîk de belav dibe, di sala 2011an de hat temamkirin.


Ji zû ve tê zanîn ku di gerdûnê de «lezkerên xwezayî yên parçeyan» hene. Ev lezkerên xwezayî parçeyan bi enerjiya ku dikare bi mîlyonan caran ji enerjiya ku di her laboratûareke li ser Dinyayê de dikare ji parçeyan re bê dayîn mezintir be, dişînin fezayê. Lê hê jî nayê zanîn ku ev lezkerên xwezayî çi ne, li ku ne û bi kîjan pêvajoyan dikarin ew qas enerjiyeke bilind bidin parçeyan.


Ji ber ku notrîno dikarin bêyî ku enerjiya xwe winda bikin an jî arasteya xwe biguherînin, rêyên pir dirêj bibirin, ev yek tê vê wateyê ku notrîno, li gorî parçeyên din, dikarin agahiyên pir zêdetir derbarê lezkerên xwezayî yên parçeyan de peyda bikin.


Piştî ku avakirina dedektora IceCube temam bû, di demeke kin de dest bi tesbîtkirinên pêşîn ên notrîno kirin. Çend salan şûnda, yekem gotarê zanistî derbarê notrînoyên ku ji kûrahiya fezayê dihatin, hat weşandin. Bi vî awayî lêkolînên li ser çavkaniyên notrînoyên gerdûnê dest pê kirin. Têkiliyên ku dedektora IceCube hîn jî tomar dike, yê alîkariya baştir fêmkirina xwezaya lezkerên razber ên parçeyan bike ku notrînoyên enerjiya bilind hilberînin. Her wiha, îhtîmal heye ku ev çavdêrî diyardeyên kozmolojîk ên ku berê nedihat zanîn jî derxe holê.


(AÖ/AY)

author: Unknown
title: Li ser rêya Arjen Arî
content:
30ê Cotmehê ji roja peşka hezkirina helbestê li min ketî ve xemgîniyekê bi xwe re tîne ji bo min. Bêguman 30ê Cotmehê salvegera wefatkirina helbestvanê gewre ya Arjen Arî ye.


Her ew dîmen, dengê wî yê dawûdî dibêje “Şêrgele hene” , “Li hezê digerim", “Hesret û meyl û tenahî, ne şiyar im ne razayî, li ber çavên min tu xuyayî” ez her di wan çavên wî de dîminim û dikevim pey heft xweziyên ku hema careke tenê min wî nas bikira û di gotûbêjekî de an jî di şeveke helbestê de wî gohdar bikira. Piştre jî dikevim pey hesabên salên ew dijîya û di rojnameya Azadiya Welat de dinivîsî çima ne di wê ferqê de bûm û hişê min li ku bû, çima hema hinge serê miskalê jî bûya min helbesta wî teaman dibe… gelek tişt û mijarên bi vî rengî xwe bi xweziyan li dora min di zîzikênin.


Bêguman ev xwezî û hestên min ê takekes in û Arjen Arî îro navê helbesta kurmancî bixwe ye.  Ez bi van gotin û fikran di nav  Pêşbirka Helbestê ya Arjen Arî de bi çepikên kesên tev li pêşbirkê bûyî ve veciniq îm.


Êrê îsal jî wek her 12 salên borî Xelatên ji pêşbirka Arjen Arî li Amedê bi merasîmeke mûtewazî hatin dayîn. Xelatgirên îsal Simeya H. Lalîn (Hestiyên Tivinga Min) û Hoşeng Nîzarî (Bîra Biyabanê) bûn.


Tê zanîn ku ( Erê tê zanîn, tê zanîn lê divê di her dem û firsendê de em balê bikşînin ser girîngî û qiymeta dosyayên ji vê pêşbirkê derkevin ) Pêşbirka Helbestê ya Arjen Arî 12 sal berê yanî piştî mirina wî 2 sal şûn de destpê dike. Armanca ji vê pêşbirkê jî ew e ku tovê helbesta kurmancî bi rahikên helbesta Arjen Arî hê şêntir û dewlemendtir bibe. Êdî di sala pêşîn ya pêşbirkê de dosyaya Selamî Esen a bi navê “Qijikên Xêrê” bi ser dikeve, salek şûn de jî bi dosyaya navê “Anatomiya Demsalên Zer” Yehya Omerî û ji xeynî 2016 û sala 2024an, her sal dosyayek bi ked û xebatên mezin tên xelatkirin. Vêce îsal jî du dosya bi ser ketin û ev jî ji bo helbesta kurdî cihê serbilindîyê ye.


Bêguman pêşbirka helbestê ji pêşbirkekê wêdetir e. Herdû dosyayên îsal ne di nav de di hemû dosyayên xelatgiran de mirov dibîne ku naverok û hewldanên her dosyayekê ji yên din hêjatir in. Hema bêjin zimanekî resen, têra xwe kurdewar û esîl di her helbesta dosyayekê de hatiye bikaranîn. Pêşbirk rêya helbestê ji bo kesên bixwazin binivîsînin, helbesta kurdî ji xwe re xistî derd, dibe xerîte. Di vê nivîsê de dibe ku yek bi yek ne pêkan be em qala her 12 dosyayan bikin ji ber wê jî, her yek ji wan hewceyî xwendin û nirxandin û rexneyê ne…


Di merasîma xelatdayîna îsal de wek gelek kesan ez jî bi navê jinekê ku xelat girtiye re pir kêf xweş û dilşad bûm. Di vê pêşbirka bi salane tê kirin de piştî Narîn Yukler-Rê û Rêç îsal jî Simeha H. Lalîn bêguman pêşî li qelema jinan jî firehtir dike.


Pêşbirka Helbestê Ya Arjen Arî ji Selamî Esen heta Simeya û Hoşeng Nîzarî her yek ji wan rengek û hevsengiyeke helbesta kurdî ne. Derîyek e ji bo helbesta kurdî.


(BK/AY)

author: Bulatlat Contributors
title: Thousands of farmlands in Bicol converted to mining, energy, infra projects
content:
Claiming the Land: Kilusang Magbubukid ng Bicol provides assistance to affected farmers and members of the local peasant group in Bula, Camarines Sur. (Photo By Reynard Magtoto/Bulatlat)

Farmers organizations warned that agricultural land conversion and large-scale development projects could displace farming communities, threaten food production and undermine farmers’ access to land.

Farmers organizations in the Bicol region have raised concerns over alleged land grabbing and agricultural land conversion involving haciendas, mining operations, renewable energy developments and infrastructure projects.

The farmers travelled to Manila late in October to call on the Marcos Jr. administration to stop land grabbing and land-use conversion of agricultural lands.

In Camarines Norte, peasant groups identified 25,000 hectares associated with the Mabilo Copper-Gold Project, while another 64,884 hectares were linked to a renewable energy development in Mount Labo.

An additional 321 hectares were identified in connection with mining operations in the province.

In Albay, the organizations identified several disputed landholdings, including 141 hectares at Hacienda Mitra/Illas in Guinobatan, 130 hectares at Hacienda Alsua in Pio Duran, 250 hectares at Hacienda Asistio in Ligao, and 200 hectares at Hacienda Ribaya, also in Ligao.

Another 78 hectares were identified at a Hacienda Alsua property, alongside 34 hectares associated with the expansion of Bicol University.

Agricultural land conversion was also reported in Daraga, including 148 hectares for the core site of Bicol International Airport and another 200 hectares for its expansion site.

An additional 110 hectares were identified for conversion associated with the Cagraray Eco-Park and Misibis Bay development.

In Camarines Sur, peasant organizations identified 817 hectares allegedly affected by land grabbing allegedly involving the Tuazon/Lao family in Bula, 244 hectares at Hacienda Veneracion in Pamplona, and 1,014 hectares in Barangay San Ramon, Siruma.

The groups also cited 309 hectares associated with the Naga Agro-Industrial Complex and between 300 and 500 hectares for an airport extension in Naga City.

In Masbate, peasant groups identified 1,807 hectares at Hacienda Pecson in Cawayan, and 13,000 hectares allegedly affected by land grabbing involving the Wanglo/Belon family in Aroroy.

Meanwhile, 700 hectares at Hacienda Beringer were identified in Sorsogon, alongside other land disputes and conversion projects.

In Catanduanes, the groups reported 111 hectares allegedly affected by land grabbing in Gigmoto.

Farmers organizations warned that agricultural land conversion and large-scale development projects could displace farming communities, threaten food production and undermine farmers’ access to land.

Farmers defending their land are met with state violence, according to the data from human rights organization Karapatan Bicol. The group reported 342 incidents of alleged human rights violations from July 2022 to July 2026 across the region.

The organization documented 28 victims of extrajudicial killings, 297 cases of threats, harassment and intimidation, 146 cases of coercion, 91 cases of red-tagging, and 75 violations of freedom of association.

It also documented 23 political prisoners, and 55 cases involving attacks on or the use of schools, medical facilities, religious institutions and other public places for military purposes.

Camarines Sur recorded the highest number of reported incidents at 212, followed by Albay with 48, Sorsogon with 42, Masbate with 27, Camarines Norte with 11, and Catanduanes with two.

Karapatan Bicol accused state security forces and the National Task Force to End Local Communist Armed Conflict (NTF-ELCAC) of involvement in intimidation and other alleged abuses targeting rural communities and peasant organizations.

The organization also raised concerns about military operations in farming communities, alleging that these have contributed to fear and restrictions on organizing. (RVO)

title: Preparativos Zapatistas para el Encuentro Abrazo con familias Buscadoras. Parte 4: Un Comando en Problemas
content:
Música: Ely Guerra, «Colmena» Imágenes, edición y producción: Terci@s Compas Zapatistas

La delegación zapatista está en la celebración del cumpleaños del SubPedro este 26 de octubre (caído en combate en la toma de la cabecera municipal de “Las Margaritas”), homenaje que cada año se le hace en estos 32 años. Hay poemas, canciones, corridos, adivinanzas y baile.

Yo estoy sentado, esperando en vano que me manden tamales, manque estén crudos. De lejos miro lo que ocurre:

La Verónica (8 años cumplidos y en diciembre cumple 9 o sea que entra en 10), jefa del tristemente célebre “Comando Palomitas”, espera con paciencia a que el SubMoy salga de una de las reuniones de la dirección zapatista. En lo que se puede llamar, “maniobra de flanqueo”, intercepta al Coordinador en jefe de la Gira por la Vida -Capítulo México, y le suelta sin anestesia:

El SubMoy responde casi de inmediato: “¿Tenemos?, eso me suena a Unión Europea. Tú tienes.”

En el modo Verónica, versión “comando palomitas”, eso de “tenemos un problema” es en realidad algo como “yo hice un problema, a ti te toca resolverlo.”

La escuincla, niña o condenada chamaca del demonio, obvia la observación crítica del SubMoy y sintetiza:

El SubMoy se detiene. “¿Cuáles playeras? No sé nada de playeras.” La Verónica ataca:

“Es que ya llegaron nuevas palomitas y no tienen playera, ¿cómo van a saber que somos Palomitas si no tenemos playera?”

“Pues por las travesuras que hacen. Dejen de hacer y ahí lo vemos si hay playeras o no”, dice el SubMoy.

La Verónica ya va preparada y contraargumenta: “¿Cómo no vamos a hacer travesuras si somos niñas? De balde somos niñas entonces. El capitán dice que todas las niñas tienen derecho de hacer travesuras, sólo los niños no, porque los castigan.” (Nota de la redacción: no es cierto, yo no dije eso).

“Ah”, respira aliviado el SubMoy, “entonces véanlo con el capitán. Va en su cuenta de él, no mía”. Se va.

La Verónica se enfila, gruñendo, a donde me encuentro. Trato de incorporarme y huir, pero me caigo y, en lo que me recupero, la nueva tropa del Comando Palomitas me rodea y pone cerco. Sospecho que no es para protegerme sino para que no escape.

“¿Por qué voy a sufrir antes? Qué tarda en que la escuela, la tarea, el cargo en la comunidad, la regla que se llama menstruación, luego los novios – mejor varios, por si uno falla-, los amores y desamores, luego la pareja de que ya te vas a sosegar, luego las crías, y, cuando vas a dar cuenta, ya estás en la menopausia. Vamos a tener hasta bisnietos y tras que no tenemos playera. De una vez no se puede creer.”

Yo no he dicho nada. Miro a todos lados con desesperación.

“Pero le dije al Monarca que se necesita la lista y las tallas, para encargar las playeras”, me defiendo.

“Ya le entregué”, dice la condenada chamaca del demonio.

Monarca se hace pato, mirando el suelo y dice “voy a revisar la camioneta”.

“No te huyas Monarca”, le grita la Verónica, “si bien que te di la lista”.

La mentada lista es un papel partido en dos donde, de puño y letra de la Verónica, están los nombres de las nuevas integrantes del Comando Palomitas y sus tallas. Una imagen de la lista la pueden ver aquí:

Con una aplicación especial que descifra todos los códigos habidos y por haber, sale una especie de traducción. Una analista, especialista en arqueología y lenguas extrañas, descifra un nombre: “Sofilla”. Y con eso, resolver el resto es más sencillo.

La Verónica explica que ella cumplió a tiempo y que va en su cuenta de Monarca si no entregó. Reta al Monarca, que se refugia tras la móvil.

Entonces la Verónica declama: “Pido juicio por combate y escojo a La Pelusa como mi campeona”. La Pelusa es una perrita que tal cual, es pequeña como una pelusa, pero es brava como el que más: defiende a las gallinas y a los gatitos de los tlacuaches y ratas (sin agraviar), y los gavilanes ya ni siquiera se acercan a las champas.

Como el Tzotz anda chamaqueando con una perrita, al Monarca ya sólo le queda el Tragón como opción. El Tragón está tirado panza arriba, disfrutando de un sol que tardó en llegar después de días de lluvia fiera.

Yo le hago una seña al Monarca. Él entiende: “compañero capitán, que dijo el SubMoy que hay que checar el registro con el Frayba”.

Nos escapamos. Pero lo que me preocupa es que alcancé a ver que el Comando Palomitas en pleno se reunía en círculo para conspirar.

¿Ustedes creen que debo preocuparme?

Los tamales nunca llegaron, pero en cambio mandaron unos panes que parecen piedras. El …

author: Kodao Productions
title: Commercialization of Bilibid land would violate prisoners’ rights, KAPATID warns
content:
Political prisoners’ support group KAPATID asked the Commission on Human Rights (CHR) to protect the rights of persons deprived of liberty (PDL), warning of a Bureau of Corrections’ (BuCor) plan to close and commercialize the New Bilibid Prison (NBP) reservation by 2028.


The group said the plan may escalate into a “dual human rights and land displacement crisis” that would force prisoner transfers and residents’ evictions.


“We are deeply concerned that the impending closure threatens not only prisoners facing forced transfers but also long-time residents facing displacement. Residents have sent distress messages reporting as many as three eviction notices, with proceedings already underway,” KAPATID spokesperson Fides Lim said.


Lim demands a full disclosure of BuCor’s land-use plan on the 366.7-hectare public property as well as a congressional inquiry in PDL conditions at the country’s biggest jail facility.


At the CHR’s civil society consultation on the Human Rights Situationer on Persons Deprived of Liberty (PDLs) on Wednesday, KAPATID urged the CHR to press for a halt to transfers and evictions pending a human rights review.


Protect NBP lands


KAPATID’s also launched its “Protect NBP Lands” campaign, calling for transparency, accountability, and meaningful participation by affected communities and civil society in decisions on the reservation’s future.


“Decongestion must not become a pretext for commercial development at the expense of human rights,” Lim said.


“Transferring prisoners to already overcrowded facilities merely shifts the problem elsewhere, while threatening family ties, access to medical care, and legal counsel,” she added.


KAPATID said it shares CHR’s concern over the need to scrutinize BuCor’s actual land-use plan.


The reservation is 52.79% larger than Bonifacio Global City while BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio Catapang Jr. has cited projected annual revenues of ₱1 billion to ₱2 billion from commercialization.


“People deserve to know how this public property will be used and who stands to benefit,” Lim said.


Bucor plans to transfer NBP


KAPATID also questioned plans to relocate the NBP. “NBP must be retained at its present site because it serves a population overwhelmingly rooted in Luzon,” Lim said.


BuCor data as of September 30, 2026 show that 88.91% or 18,110 of NBP’s 20,369 PDLs come from Luzon, including 62.20% from Metro Manila, CALABARZON, and Central Luzon.


Meanwhile, reported occupancy rates reach 573% at Iwahig Penal Farm, 504% at Leyte Regional Prison, and 399% at San Ramon Prison and Penal Farm.


KAPATID said the planned transfers could constitute cruel, inhuman or degrading treatment or punishment under the UN Convention Against Torture, the Nelson Mandela Rules, the Anti-Torture Act, and other applicable laws.


It called on the CHR to investigate whether forced transfers, considering their foreseeable effects on family contact, health care, and conditions in overcrowded receiving facilities.


“Genuine decongestion means reducing the prison population through timely, lawful releases—not simply transferring overcrowding elsewhere,” Lim said.


KAPATID reiterated its calls for expedited processing of prison records and time allowances, swift action for executive clemency, the prompt release of those who have served their sentences, and humanitarian release for the very elderly and seriously ill. #

(Raymund B. Villanueva)

title: Halkın yüzde 57'si erken seçim istiyor; parlamentoda ülkeyi seçime götürme iradesi yok
content:
Türkiye'de erken genel seçim isteyenlerin oranı yüzde 57,2'ye ulaşırken, siyasi partiler arasında seçimlerin ne zaman ve hangi koşullarda yapılacağına ilişkin tartışmalar, Cumhurbaşkanı Recep Tayyip Erdoğan'ın yeniden adaylığı sorunu etrafında düğümleniyor.


ASAL Araştırma'nın 30 Ekim'de kamuoyuna yansıyan kamuoyu yoklaması sonuçlarına göre erken seçim istemeyenlerin oranı yüzde 33,5'e gerilerken, yüzde 9,3'ü görüş bildirmedi.


Seçmen çoğunluğunun olağan seçim tarihini beklemek istemediğini gösteren anket, CHP yönetimine yargı kararıyla yeniden getirilen Kemal Kılıçdaroğlu'nun erken seçime ilişkin birbiriyle gerilimli açıklamalar yaptığı, Yeni Parti Genel Başkanı Özgür Özel'in ise Cumhurbaşkanı Başdanışmanı Mehmet Uçum'un 2028 seçim formülüne karşı çıktığı dönemde yayımlandı.


Erken seçim isteyenler iki yılda 14,6 puan arttı


ASAL'ın 4-10 Ekim tarihlerinde 28 ilde, 18 yaş üstü 2 bin 20 kişiyle bilgisayar destekli telefon görüşmesi yöntemiyle gerçekleştirdiği araştırmada, katılımcılara "Sizce erken genel seçim yapılmalı mı?" sorusu yöneltildi.


Erken seçim isteyenlerin oranı Ekim 2024'te yüzde 42,6 iken Ocak 2025'te yüzde 50,3'e, Ocak 2026'da yüzde 54,4'e çıktı. Mart 2026'da yüzde 58,9'a ulaşan talep, nisanda yüzde 54,5'e geriledikten sonra ekimde kısmi yükselişle yüzde 57,2 olarak ölçüldü.


İki yıllık artış 14,6 puan. Aynı dönemde erken seçime karşı çıkanların oranı yüzde 51,5'ten yüzde 33,5'e indi.


Araştırmanın hata payı yüzde 95 güven düzeyinde artı-eksi 2,41 puan olarak açıklandı. Dolayısıyla nisan-ekim arasındaki 2,7 puanlık fark tek başına kesin bir yön değişikliği kanıtı sayılmasa da iki yıllık ölçümler erken seçim isteyenlerin belirgin biçimde çoğaldığını gösteriyor. 


Anketin saha çalışması, siyasi liderlerin ekim ayının ikinci yarısındaki açıklamalarından önce yapıldı. Sonuçlar söz konusu açıklamalara tepki değil, daha önce oluşmuş bir seçmen eğiliminin göstergesi.  olarak değerlendirilmeli.


Kılıçdaroğlu: "Yangın yerindeyken hangi erken seçimi yapacaksınız?"


CHP'nin başına mutlak butlan kararıyla yeniden getirilen Kemal Kılıçdaroğlu, 22 Ekim'de Ankara'da gazetecilerle buluşmasında erken seçim talebine mesafeli yaklaşmıştı:


"Ülke bu haldeyken, yangın yerindeyken hangi erken seçimi yapacaksınız?"


Kılıçdaroğlu, ekonomideki kötüleşmeyi, yolsuzlukları, gelir dağılımındaki bozulmayı ve yaygınlaşan yoksulluğu sıralayarak erken seçimin gerekçesini sorguladı.


Ancak Kılıçdaroğlu'nun erken seçimin neden yapılamayacağına gerekçe olarak gösterdiği sorunlar, erken seçim isteyenlerin taleplerinin üzerinde yükseldiği başlıca toplumsal ve politik koşullar arasında yer alıyor.


Kılıçdaroğlu, açıklamalarına yönelik eleştirilerin ardından 24 Ekim'de Gaziantep'in Karkamış ilçesinde gazetecilerle yeniden konuştuğunda ilk beyanını Erdoğan'ın seçime gitmeyeceğine dair öngörüne dayandırdığını iddia etti ve erken seçimden yana olduğunu söyledi: 


"Erken seçim kararı alınabilirse bir an önce seçim olmasını isteriz."


Ancak bu açıklama, kendisinin erken seçim ve iktidar değişikliği için bir siyasal inisiyatif alma iradesini değil, kendileri dışında alınacak bir karara ayak uydurma eğiliminin dile getirilmesinden öteye gitmedi. 


Kılıçdaroğlu'nun ikinci konuşmasında asıl dikkat çekici olan ise seçimlerin Nisan 2028'de yenilenmesine ilişkin soruya verdiği yanıttı.


Erdoğan'ın adaylık formülüne de "Varız"


Gazeteciler, Kılıçdaroğlu'na seçimlerin Nisan 2028'e alınması teklifine destek verip vermeyeceğini sordu.


Kılıçdaroğlu'nun yanıtı kısa ve açıktı:


"Hayır, varız."


Nisan 2028, yalnızca genel seçimleri erkene almak için öylesine ortaya atılmış bir tarih değildi. Cumhurbaşkanı Başdanışmanı Mehmet Uçum Erdoğan'ın yeniden adaylığını mümkün kılmak amacıyla aylardır savunduğu takvimde 16 Nisan 2028'i "Cumhurbaşkanı Erdoğan'ın adaylığının hukukileştirilmesi" tarihi olarak öneriyordu. 


Kılıçdaroğlu gazetecilerin bu tutumunun Erdoğan'ın önünü açabileceğini hatırlatmasını Erdoğan'ın yeniden aday olacağını düşünmediği varsayımıyla  reddetti.


Üç haftalık değişiklikle dördüncü adaylık


Erdoğan, 2014, 2018 ve 2023'te cumhurbaşkanı seçildi. 2028'deki adaylığı, tarihsel olarak dördüncü cumhurbaşkanlığı adaylığı olacak.


İktidarın hukuki yorumu ise 2018'de yürürlüğe giren cumhurbaşkanlığı sistemini esas alıyor. Bu yoruma göre Erdoğan 2023'te ikinci dönemine başladı ve Anayasa'nın 116. maddesindeki istisnadan yararlanabilir.

author: Tori Noble
title: Rewriting Copyright Law for Generative AI Would Hurt Everyone
content:
In courts across the country, publishers and creators are suing large AI companies for training generative AI models on copyrighted works. It’s easy to see these cases as a David-and-Goliath showdown between authors and publishers fighting for a cut of Big Tech company profits. But this fight is actually much larger. It affects billions of people who aren’t represented in the case at all, including researchers, artists, activists, journalists, people with disabilities, and anyone who accesses and shares content online.   


That’s why EFF is stepping in to defend the

public’s

 rights in these cases. Today, EFF filed an

amicus brief

 in

In re OpenAI,

 explaining how the court’s ruling on fair use could impact people worldwide. If fair use gets narrowed, it will impede work that benefits the public, like medical research and investigative journalism, and even limit access to privacy protection tools.


Let’s be clear: creators and workers deserve support as AI changes their fields, and Big Tech companies must be held accountable for the harms they cause. But giving copyright holders more control over the web won’t accomplish either of these goals. If the plaintiffs prevail in these cases, courts would have to rewrite copyright law in ways that hurt everyone except powerful media and tech companies.


Rewriting Fair Use Makes Everyone Worse Off


Copyright exists for one reason: to stimulate creativity and innovation in service of the greater public good. Unfortunately, the plaintiffs in this lawsuit are arguing to limit everyone’s fair use rights, in ways that would thwart the basic purpose of copyright. The harms of shrinking fair use will go far beyond generative AI, impacting everyone.


Initial speculation that AI models would be infringement machines, churning out works highly similar to those on which they were trained,

has proven unfounded

. And courts have already found fair use in cases where copyrighted works were used to train generative AI models, recognizing that training uses those works for

a fundamentally different purpose

.


Plaintiffs in these cases argue that, even if the use is transformative, using their works to train AI is still unfair, because the AI models could generate new, non-infringing works that might compete with plaintiffs’ own works. They also argue that scraping or downloading the data without permission—or in some cases, from websites containing infringing copies—was independently infringing and/or rendered any subsequent uses of that data unfair.


These arguments would put beneficial research and reporting at risk. First, if copying without permission rules out fair use, the law will never protect transformative uses that benefit us all. Researchers, journalists, and other watchdog groups gather information the same way AI companies do—but they do it to serve the public interest, and often to hold Big Tech itself accountable. For example, journalists and nonprofit researchers have used “crawling” or “scraping”

to investigate potentially anticompetitive practices by tech companies

, and

research misinformation and hateful content posted on X

. Their data acquisition techniques are virtually identical to those used by AI giants—but they lack those companies’ deep pockets.


Requiring users to show that copyrighted material was lawfully obtained would also threaten everyday internet use. As EFF’s brief explained, that requirement would “cast legal doubt on the billions of copies we collectively make every day through routine online activities like opening emails, clicking on an embedded link, visiting websites, sharing pictures, streaming music, and watching videos. All of this activity requires intermediate copying.”


Fair use is what lets us all use the internet without being compelled to track the source of every image, video, and article that we click on, and make sure the rights are all cleared.


Additionally, while rightsholders are understandably concerned about competition from AI generated works,

copyright law exists to

promote new creation

, not protect authors who published first. Under the plaintiffs’ theory, no one could stand upon the shoulders of giants. Copyright could prevent people from writing new books inspired by themes in a favorite novel or genre, or prevent academic researchers from publishing literature reviews that distill insights from prior research—simply because readers might prefer those new publications over those that came first …
